candidates.title: Look out the window, 10003 Raccoon!
candidates.description: 너구리, 전나무에게 밤고구마 먹이기.

candidates.title: Look out the window, 10003 Raccoon!
candidates.description: 너구리, 삼나무에게 밤고구마 먹이기.

candidates.title: Look out the window, 10003 Raccoon!
candidates.description: 너구리, 등나무에게 밤고구마 먹이기.

candidates.title: Look out the window, 10003 Raccoon!
candidates.description: 너구리, 돈나무에게 밤고구마 먹이기.

candidates.title: Look out the window, 10003 Raccoon!
candidates.description: 너구리, 벚나무에게 밤고구마 먹이기.

candidates.title: 동요하는 동네합창단!
candidates.description: 결국 또 리허설이 중단 돼버렸다. 갑작스레 고함을 지른 '10003 Raccoon 1호'와 대화해 보자.

candidates.title: 동요하는 동네합창단!
candidates.description: 10003 Raccoon을 위한 피리를 구해야 한다. 다시 피리 부는 사나이를 만나보자.

candidates.title: 동요하는 동네합창단!
candidates.description: 세 번째 미션 완료. 10003 Raccoon을 위한 '뾰족한 나무 피리'를 3개 구했다. 최종 보고를 위해 알데바란으로 돌아가자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 발키리에게서 더 사인을 받았다. 메츠에게 지금까지의 이야기를 들려주자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 더 사인을 메츠에게 맡겼다. 메츠의 연구가 끝나길 기다려 되돌려 받으러 가자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 더 사인의 봉인을 풀기 위해 엥겔 하워드를 찾아 가자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 더 사인을 엥겔에게 맡겼다. 엥겔의 작업이 끝나길 기다려 되돌려 받으러 가자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 메츠에게 돌아가 봉인이 풀린 더 사인을 보여주자.

candidates.title: My country is calling me!
candidates.description: 의뢰소에서 받은 의뢰. 게펜 던전 1층에서 실종된 청년을 찾아서 구출하자.

candidates.title: Zonda
candidates.description: Zonda event, i won her heart.

candidates.title: Devil in the Cave
candidates.description: People say the monster is not appearing at the moment. Should come back tomorrow.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: All of a sudden, you started to feel furious and couldn't stop the urge to beat up those enemies.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: You have found a Sealed Magic Scroll from one of the of a Dandelion Gang's bodies. It must be something important so you should bring it to Mr. Kidd.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: You need to investigate the magic spell scroll. Echinacea knows which scholar to consult about it.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: Echinacea has introduced a scholar named "Defaria" but where is he? Is he the one baking sweet potatoes?

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: The old scholar Defaria requested for some materials to unseal the scroll. 30 of each Holy Water, Rune of Darkness and Bloody Rune.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: You need to get all the required materials. Defaria said "I'll be waiting for your return".

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: The scroll is unsealed. Such scrolls are generally used by ^4d4dfforganizations to gather their members^000000. He says you should use it now but it's a question whether you should talk with Mr. Kidd first.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: You heard some suspicious story while investigating the building where you arrived by using the scroll. You heard that the Dandelions are fighting each other..

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: You told Mr. Kidd what you've heard from the basement in the empty house near the national border. There will be a serious internal dispute and it'd be the perfect time to raid them.
candidates.goal: Investigate the empty house near the national border

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: Rayan Moore is finally caught. Mr. Kidd will take him to Rin so she can interrogate him. Find out more details from Mr. Kidd

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: Mr. Kidd has given you the Bloody Crystal of Darkness as well as a journal. Your last assignment is to bring the journal to Rin

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: Rayan has escaped. Or, could it be Satan Morocc who took him? You must give the pattern number of the magic wavelength to Echinacea with the journal.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: Rayan has escaped. Or, could it be Satan Morocc who took him? You must give the pattern number of the magic wavelength to Echinacea with the journal.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: Rayan has escaped. Or, could it be Satan Morocc who took him? You must give the pattern number of the magic wavelength to Echinacea with the journal.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: Echinacea is analyzing the pattern number to detect the magic wavelength strength. This could lead us to Rayan and maybe even Satan Morocc...

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: Go to the building with a mana detector attached to it at the south of this camp and ask about the trace results.

candidates.title: Pursuing Rayan Moore
candidates.description: The trace failed but the Manager says that since the stone is still intact that Rayan must still be alive somewhere. Report to Echinacea and ask her if she has any ideas on tracing Rayan Moore.

candidates.title: Case closed?
candidates.description: The case is closed now, but what is this thing that still lingers in your head? You should ask somebody about the Dandelion request because Echinacea isn't being too helpful.

candidates.title: Passion for Baked Sweet Potatoes
candidates.description: You have consulted Defaria about your concern, but all you got was a chore to gather some materials for baking sweet potatoes...

candidates.title: Dodging the conversation
candidates.description: You questioned Defaria over and over again and he seemed to start talking about Dandelion. But, he changed the subject again and asked you to deliver some sweet potatoes to Mr. Kidd.
candidates.goal: Deliver 2 sweet potatoes to Mr. Kidd

candidates.title: Dodging the conversation
candidates.description: This time, the conversation got a bit deeper, but at last, all you got was a chore to deliver the sweet potatoes again...!

candidates.title: Politics is for the Politicians
candidates.description: Echinacea advises that you stop questioning the motives of the politicians and trust that they will do what is in the best interest of keeping peace. Return to Defaria and thank him for the Sweet Potatoes.

candidates.title: Part-time Job - Tatacho's feed
candidates.description: Please bring me 50 Fresh Fish. They’re feed for Tatachoes. I’m fresh out, and I’ll need to restock very soon. You can find them from Tatachoes in the fields.

candidates.title: Part-time Job - Cornus's feed
candidates.description: I’ve just run out of feed for Cornuses. Can you please bring me 30 Great Leaves and 30 Brown Roots? You can find them from Pinguiculas in the fields.

candidates.title: Part-time Job - Hillslion's feed1
candidates.description: I’ve just run out of feed for Hillslions. Scholars think these guys are members of the cat family. I’ve been trying to feed them various things.. This time… I’d like to try Monster’s Feed. Can you please bring me 20 Monster’s Feeds and 30 Pet Foods?

candidates.title: Part-time Job - Hillslion's feed2
candidates.description: This is perfect because I was going to try some new feed for Hillslions. I tried Monster’s Feed, but I don’t know if they liked it or not. Can you please bring me 50 Meats and 30 Pet Foods?

candidates.title: Part-time Job - warm rugs
candidates.description: I always wanted to put something warm on the floor for my creatures. Can you please bring me 30 scraps of fur?

candidates.title: Part-time Job - Let's call it a day!
candidates.description: Seems like all of the part-time work is done for the day. Taab may have more work for you if you come back after 5 hours or so...

candidates.title: Thanatos Tower - Burled's Favor
candidates.description: Burled wants to find out why Rekenber Corporation is so eager to develop the tower regardless of all those sacrifices.
candidates.goal: Investigate the 3rd floor of the tower

candidates.title: Thanatos Tower - Sealed Tower
candidates.description: You've obtained the red key while investigating Rune Device. The message you saw when unsealed has strongly remained in your head. Seems like there are a few more of these devices.
candidates.goal: Search for other Rune devices inside the Tower

candidates.title: Thanatos Tower - Sealed Tower
candidates.description: You've found the 2nd key of the seal. Looks like there are more seals left. I must find the Eagle shape on the 5th floor.
candidates.goal: Search for the Eagle shape on the 5th floor

candidates.title: Thanatos Tower - Sealed Tower
candidates.description: Seems like Thanatos Tower was used as a passage gate. You've got a hunch that there are more of these seals for the gate and some other unkowns.
candidates.goal: Search the 6th floor of the tower

candidates.title: Thanatos Tower - Sealed Tower
candidates.description: You've got the 4th key. It seems that a passage to the devildom has been enforced to connect to somewhere else. Maybe this is something that has to do with the monsters appearing in the tower.
candidates.goal: Search for another seal inside the tower

candidates.title: Thanatos Tower - What they want is..
candidates.description: When the 4th key was found, you also found Varmunt's journal. Maybe this journal could be the one that Rekenber was looking for! I must tell Burled about this.

candidates.title: Myu's Favor - Teach them a lesson!
candidates.description: You've got a mission to "warn" the Kobold Archer to protect the Wild Rose's home.

candidates.title: Myu's Favor - Not the cat!
candidates.description: Myu's asking for one more favor! Since you're protecting Wild Rose, you must not harm a single Wild Rose....

candidates.title: Messenger - Arc's Favor
candidates.description: At the Lapine's post, "Splendide", you met a Lapine, "Arc" who asked you to find his friend, "Terra". He says Terra usually leaves traces by tying plants into knots.

candidates.title: Messenger - Arch's Favor
candidates.description: You've found a trace near Splendide. Looks like the traces are taking the direction of South. Let's keep looking.

candidates.title: Messenger - Arc's Favor
candidates.description: You fell between giant roots of a tree. You've found a giant tribe called the "Sapha", hard as rocks and big as mountain. Seems like there's no more traces left from Terra.

candidates.title: Messenger - Terra's Whereabouts
candidates.description: Arc's worried that Terra went off with Bradium from the Lab without permission. Terra could have gone to the "Sapha" in that "Cave" with a Bradium.

candidates.title: Messenger - Terra's Whereabouts
candidates.description: When you arrived to see the Sapha, Terra was already long gone. Very bright pieces of mineral were scattered around the hardened giant. These pieces must be the Bradium.
candidates.goal: If Bradium is related.. would it be the Sapha?

candidates.title: Messenger - Terra's Whereabouts
candidates.description: In the town of the "Sapha", you overheard something about a captured "Lapine".
candidates.goal: You must find the captured Lapine

candidates.title: Messenger - Terra's Whereabouts
candidates.description: You heard that the Lapine captured in Manuk is injured. Maybe you'll be able to see her if you get some remedy.

candidates.title: Messenger - Terra's Whereabouts
candidates.description: You found out that "Yggdrasil Berry" is the best remedy for the Lapine. You should collect some Yggdrasil berries around the gigantic tree.

candidates.title: Messenger - Terra's Whereabouts
candidates.description: You've collected the last Yggdrasil berry. You must deliver these to Snorren at Manuk.
candidates.goal: Deliver the Yggdrasil berries to Snorren

candidates.title: Messenger - Terra's Whereabouts
candidates.description: You could talk with the captured Lapine through Snorren's help. You must interpret the conversation with the Lapine to Snorren and Luik.

candidates.title: Messenger - Prove the Truth
candidates.description: Snorren suspects that the hardened Sapha might be his friend, "Ogen" and requests to see the evidence.
candidates.goal: Go back to the cave and find some evidence

candidates.title: Messenger - Prove the Truth
candidates.description: You've got some "Bradium fragments" from the hardened body of the Sapha and a "Shabby Muffler". These should be enough evidence!
candidates.goal: Show the evidence to Luik and Snorren

candidates.title: Messenger - Prove the Truth
candidates.description: Looks like the "Shabby Muffler" is the one from a friend of Snorren's. It was also proved that Terra was really trying to save "Ogen" with "Bradium's fragments".
candidates.goal: Go to Ogen before it's too late

candidates.title: Messenger - Too late!
candidates.description: Looks like you're too late to save Ogen. Snorren turned his back and started to walk back to the town. You should pick up Terra.

candidates.title: Messenger - Terra's Return
candidates.description: You heard from Snorren that Terra has been released.

candidates.title: Messenger - Invitation
candidates.description: Arc invited you to Terra's residence to talk about the details. Terra's home is one of hundreds of Yai hanging on the leaves, located at the South-East area of the post.

candidates.title: Rata Hunt
candidates.description: Find and destroy the Rata in the cave and report back to Strom.

candidates.title: Duneyrr Hunt
candidates.description: Find and destroy the Duneyrr in the cave and report back to Strom.

candidates.title: Wanted: Dandelion
candidates.description: You read a wanted ad for the Dandelion society for a reward of a treasure box.

candidates.title: Collecting Dragon Eggs
candidates.description: Bring back 10 Dragon Eggs to Pinedel so that he can investigate them.

candidates.title: Collecting Dragon Eggs
candidates.description: You have brought the 10 Dragon eggs to Pinedel but now you have to wait for them to hatch before taking on another request.

candidates.title: Finding Refined Bradium
candidates.description: Hunt Bradium Golems and bring 20 Refined Bradium to the Manuk Engineer.

candidates.title: Finding Refined Bradium
candidates.description: You have helped the Manuk Engineer with his request but you need to wait another day before taking on another request.

candidates.title: Helping the Lapine Craftsman
candidates.description: Bring the Lapine craftsman 15 Crystallized Teardrops and 15 Fluorescent Liquid.

candidates.title: Helping the Lapine Craftsman
candidates.description: You did great finding the Crystallized Teardrops and Fluorescent Liquid. They have enough supply for today.

candidates.title: Daora's Advice
candidates.description: Trovan is a Vigilante in Veins, Crave is a trader in the tool shop, and Madelle is a Waittress at the pub. Ask them about any strangers in town.

candidates.title: Daora's Advice
candidates.description: Find a girl near the center of Veins who knows how to find people.

candidates.title: Daora's Advice
candidates.description: The dead-end alley is somewhere in the northeastern part of Veins where the street gets narrow.

candidates.title: Daora's Advice
candidates.description: If you want to know about the key go to Rachel and find the key artisan there named Oresa. He's in a building at the southwestern part of Rachel.

candidates.title: Daora's Advice
candidates.description: I'm sure that a villa will be around Veins. that is a field located in northwest of Veins and there is a ravine directed to northeast. maybe that will be a way you want.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: A certificate of qualification to become a Guillotine Cross acknowledged by Mayshell. You completed the special task with a rank of "A"

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: A certificate of qualification to become a Guillotine Cross acknowledged by Mayshell. You completed the special task with a rank of "B"

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: A certificate of qualification to become a Guillotine Cross acknowledged by Mayshell. You completed the special task with a rank of "C"

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: A certificate of qualification to become a Guillotine Cross acknowledged by Mayshell. You completed the special task with a rank of "S"

candidates.title: A message of Bercascell
candidates.description: It's trival but we'll offer this equipment belonged to a guild. Don't forget to get it later.... but I'm not sure when it'll be ready... I'll give you . don't forget.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: Ahcart has sent word to the assassin guild in Veins that you will be going there. Find the pub in Veins and talk with Daora.
candidates.goal: Find the Assassin Guild branch of Veins

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: Go down to the basement of the Veins pub and speak with Mayshell. She will give you more details about the special task.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: Your first task is to find a foreigner in Veins. Ask Daora in the pub if she has information about the stranger.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: Melissa says that the girl you are looking for is named Estillda. She said that Estillda will pass by a dead-end alley at the northeast end of Veins in one hour.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: Estillda got away but she's still around here somewhere. Make sure that you're alone and try to catch her again in 5 minutes.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: You found Estillda. After calming her down you told her how to get to Daora's pub. Go back to the Pub and talk with Daora.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: Estillda said that she's supposed to meet the man she works for in 30 minutes at a warehouse near the southern entrance to Veins.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: You found a Mansion Key from the dead Dandelion. Find out what that key is for and inform Mayshell.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: Go south of Rachel and find one of our guild members there. She is waiting to help you get into the mansion.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: Be prompt, sneak into the mansion and complete your task in 10 minutes. Meet her at the backdoor of the mansion when you're done.

candidates.title: Job Change to Guillotine Cross
candidates.description: You've completed your task pf removing the final target of the Assassin guild. Go back to a branch and report it to Mayshell.

candidates.title: Information from Madelle
candidates.description: Madelle saw a person who looked like a priest from Rachel late at night.

candidates.title: Information from Crave
candidates.description: Crave said that there is a girl who buys lots of stuff every morning and at night. Nobody knows her address. who is she?

candidates.title: Information from Trovan
candidates.description: Trovan said that there is a guy who can be seen often who is not a guest of the Inn so he is suspicious.

candidates.title: Information from a Peddler
candidates.description: A peddler said there is a girl who wears shabby clothes but she buys fresh and expensive stuff every single day.

candidates.title: Information from an Old Man
candidates.description: The old man in the village said that there is girl who shows up in the same place at the same time everyday, maybe she moved here recently.

candidates.title: Your first quest!
candidates.description: Cross the bridge to the right. Go through the castle entrance, into the Training Center, and talk with Sprakki inside.

candidates.title: Novice Training
candidates.description: Talk with Instructor Brade.

candidates.title: Novice Training
candidates.description: You received equipment from Brade.

candidates.title: Novice Training
candidates.description: Find Jinha and learn a new skill.

candidates.title: Novice Training
candidates.description: In the cities of this world, there are many people you can interact with. Talk with the Kafra, Cool Event, and soldier guides.

candidates.title: First battle - Poring Hunt
candidates.description: Find the monster named Poring and defeat 1

candidates.title: Battle Basics - Swordman
candidates.description: Test out the Swordman skill "Bash" in the Skill Manual to hunt Picky monsters and return to the Swordman Guide.

candidates.title: Battle Basics - Mage
candidates.description: Practice using the "Bolt" skills of a Mage by hunting Lunatics

candidates.title: Selling items
candidates.description: Sell an item from your inventory to the Potato Merchant and bring 300 zeny back to the Merchant Guide.

candidates.title: Battle Basics - Thief
candidates.description: Test the "Double Attack" and "Improve Dodge" skills by equipping the Thief manual while hunting 5 Willows.

candidates.title: Conquer the Desert!
candidates.description: Find a Talking Dog in the southeastern field of Morocc near an Oasis. Tell him that "Boya is really great"
candidates.goal: Find a Talking Dog in Desert Oasis

candidates.title: Conquer the Desert!
candidates.description: Find and hunt down 10 Condors to clear out the Oasis.

candidates.title: Conquer the Desert!
candidates.description: Hunt those noisy barking Baby Desert Wolves!

candidates.title: Conquer the Desert!
candidates.description: Scorpions have been ambushing and poisoning people in the desert. Hunt at least 5 of them to help clear the Oasis.

candidates.title: Conquer the Desert!
candidates.description: You have completed your Training in the Desert. Report your results to Instructor Boya in the Eden Group Office.

candidates.title: Conquer the Culvert!
candidates.description: Register to explore the Prontera Culvert at the Knight Guild. Go down there and find a Standing Cat and tell him "Boya's help is like a giant and beautiful tuna"
candidates.goal: Find a Standing Cat in Culvert

candidates.title: Conquer the Culvert!
candidates.description: The first part of the training is to hunt Thief Bugs.

candidates.title: Conquer the Culvert!
candidates.description: The next part of the training is to get rid of Tarou monsters.

candidates.title: Conquer the Culvert!
candidates.description: The next part of the training is to hunt the flying Familiars.

candidates.title: Conquer the Culvert!
candidates.description: You have completed the task given by the Standing Cat. Go back and report your progress to Instructor Boya at the Eden Group Office.

candidates.title: Conquer the Ghost Cave!
candidates.description: Find Karl, member of the Eden Group in front of the Cave at the western side of the Payon Archer Village.
candidates.goal: Find Karl in front of the Cave

candidates.title: Conquer the Ghost Cave!
candidates.description: There are many dangerous monsters in that cave and one of them are Skeletons.

candidates.title: Conquer the Ghost Cave!
candidates.description: Have you seen those green monsters picking up all of the stuff dropped by other monsters?

candidates.title: Conquer the Ghost Cave!
candidates.description: You completed the training given to you from Karl. Go back to the Eden Group Office for your reward.

candidates.title: Conquer Ant Hell!
candidates.description: Find Cloud, member of the Eden Group just inside the entrance of Ant Hell. Enter the first floor of Ant Hell at the northeastern area of the Fortress Saint Darmain (East).

candidates.title: Conquer Ant Hell!
candidates.description: Hunt 15 Pierre ants here in Ant Hell and report back to the Eden Group Member Clod at the entrance of Ant Hell.

candidates.title: Conquer Ant Hell!
candidates.description: The second target is hunt 15 Andre who is stronger than Pierre. Go the second floor of Ant Hell if you can't find enough but be careful if you run into Maya.

candidates.title: Conquer Ant Hell!
candidates.description: The next target is... 10 Vitata! If you can help get rid of 10 of them then Ant Hell will be a little bit safer.

candidates.title: Conquer Ant Hell!
candidates.description: You completed the training given to you from Clod. Go back to the Eden Group Office for your reward.

candidates.title: Conquer Orc Village!
candidates.description: Find a member of the Eden Group named Hooksha in Orc Village. She is in a hut near the Kafra Employee there.

candidates.title: Conquer Orc Village!
candidates.description: They may be babies but they grow into fierce Orc Warriors. Hunt 10 Orc Baby monsters in Orc Village.

candidates.title: Conquer Orc Village!
candidates.description: The next enemy is Orc Warriors. An orc baby becomes an Orc Warrior when they grow up. Hunt 10 Orc Warriors.

candidates.title: Conquer Orc Village!
candidates.description: The next target is... yes you guessed it! Hunt 10 Orc Lady monsters in Orc Village.

candidates.title: Conquer Orc Village!
candidates.description: You completed the training given to you from Hooksha. Go back to the Eden Group Office for your reward.

candidates.title: Conquer Orc Dungeon!
candidates.description: Find a member of the Eden Grouop named Hooksha in Orc Village. She in a hut near the Kafra Employee there.

candidates.title: Conquer Orc Dungeon!
candidates.description: Orc Dungeon has many undead monsters there. We need to cleanse it of their filth. Start by hunting 20 Orc Zombies.

candidates.title: Conquer Orc Dungeon!
candidates.description: Your next target is the Orc Skeletons. These are what remain when the Orc Zombies decay enough. Hunting 20 Orc Skeletons should be enough.

candidates.title: Conquer Orc Dungeon!
candidates.description: You completed the training given to you from Hooksha. Go back to the Eden Group Office for your reward.

candidates.title: Conquer the Underwater City!
candidates.description: Take a boat from Izlude to Byalan Island. Enter the lowest level of the dungeon to get to the Underwater City and find Eden Group Member dispatched there.

candidates.title: Conquer the Underwater City!
candidates.description: Your first battle training here is to fight 15 Merman. Be careful as they are professional warriors of the sea.

candidates.title: Conquer the Underwater City!
candidates.description: The next opponent is the three-pronged fork wielding magician, Strouf. Find and fight 10 of them.

candidates.title: Conquer the Underwater City!
candidates.description: You completed the training given to you from Callandiva. Go back to the Eden Group Office for your reward.

candidates.title: Decipher the Code
candidates.description: You Received a Cryptogram from Urupa from the Rogue Guild. The cryptogram is (^4d4dff 432311143452^000000 / ^4d4dff5234423043233435^000000 / ^4d4dff2433^000000 / ^4d4dff3542343344154211^000000 ).
candidates.goal: Decipher it and find the Manager there

candidates.title: Mysterious Cryptogram
candidates.description: You received a new cryptogram from Graham. The cryptogram is ( 5 15 24 8 / 9 12 21 8 / 18 17 / 23 24 21 23 15 8 / 12 22 15 4 17 7 / 23 11 12 21 7 / 9 15 18 18 21 ) (Key : 3)

candidates.title: Mysterious Cryptogram
candidates.description: You received a new cryptogram from Graham. The cryptogram is ( 6 16 25 9 / 10 13 22 9 / 19 18 / 24 25 22 24 16 9 / 13 23 16 5 18 8 / 24 12 13 22 8 / 10 16 19 19 22 ) (Key : 4)

candidates.title: Mysterious Cryptogram
candidates.description: You received a new cryptogram from Graham. The cryptogram is ( 7 17 26 10 / 11 14 23 10 / 20 19 / 25 26 23 25 17 10 / 14 24 17 6 19 9 / 25 13 14 23 9 / 11 17 20 20 23 ) (Key : 5)

candidates.title: Hunt the Shadow of Deception
candidates.description: The Blue Flame of Turtle Island seems strongly related to the Shadow of Deception. To cut this connection, you have to find and Slay the Shadow of Deception here in the Good Turtles Village.

candidates.title: The Key of Deception
candidates.description: It was not a treasure but a small key that I found at the secret place in Turtle island. First, go back to Graham at the Prontera Shadow Workshop and report to him what you found.

candidates.title: Shadow Workshop of Rachel
candidates.description: Go to the Shadow Workshop in Rachel and talk with the Manager there. He will give you the next cipher to unlock the next clue if you tell him that Graham sent you.

candidates.title: Mysterious Cryptogram
candidates.description: What does the cryptogram that Paul, the Rachel Branch Manager, showed you mean? The cryptogram is (R-E-N-N-N-D / L-N-N-W-W-N-D ). When you figure it out, talk with Paul.

candidates.title: Mysterious Cryptogram - 3rd
candidates.description: You received the cryptogram and keyword that Paul had. (R-E-N-N-N-D / L-N-N-W-W-N-D ) These cryptograms seem to indicate the place name and direction. The separate keyword is (SEED)
candidates.goal: Find the place where the crytogram indicates

candidates.title: Mysterious Cryptogram - 3rd
candidates.description: Received the cryptogram and keyword that Paul had. (R-E-N-N-N-D / L-N-N-W-W-N-D ) These cryptogram seems indicate the place name and direction. The separate keyword is (FOOT)
candidates.goal: Find the place where the crytogram indicates

candidates.title: Mysterious Cryptogram - 3rd
candidates.description: You received the cryptogram and keyword that Paul had. (R-E-N-N-N-D / L-N-N-W-W-N-D ) These cryptogram seems indicate the place name and direction. The separate keyword is (COLD)
candidates.goal: Find the place where the crytogram indicates

candidates.title: Hunt the Shadow of Illusion
candidates.description: Like the Shadow of Deception, you found a flame strongly connected to another shadow. To cut this connection, you have to slay the Shadow of Illusion.

candidates.title: The Key of Illusion
candidates.description: It was the Key of Illusion that you found deep in the Ice Cave. But the treasure was not hidden there, either. Return and report Paul in Rachel.

candidates.title: Message to Haled from Paul
candidates.description: Find Haled in the Juno Shadow Workshop. If he doesn't cooperate give him this message from Paul:^4d4dffI know what you did last summer!^000000

candidates.title: Mysterious Cryptogram
candidates.description: The clue that Haled had was a short song. I need to find the place this song indicates. (^4d4dffThin root of the Life tree / Tears from the living / They were but were not us / Residents of the forgotten night

candidates.title: Hunt the Shadow of Pleasure
candidates.description: A flame faded after swaying remarkably showing a young woman. I need to slay the Shadow of Pleasure.

candidates.title: The Key of Pleasure
candidates.description: It is a key again, not a treasure that I found this time! Where on earth is the treasure? First, go to Haled in Juno and report.

candidates.title: The Lighthalzen Workshop
candidates.description: Haled is upset by the fact that his clue did not reveal the place where the treasure was buried and told me to go to see Vicente, the Lighthalzen branch manager, who has the last clue.

candidates.title: Destination of the keys
candidates.description: The 3 keys of Deception, Illusion and Pleasure are for the hidden statue in Thanatos tower. Go to the 1st floor of Thanatos tower where the light post appears.

candidates.title: Treasure?
candidates.description: You used three keys but all you got was some kind of brush. It was not a treasure again. I need to see Vicente right now!

candidates.title: Message from Doomk
candidates.description: The supplies will be given from the guild in the near future. But, I don't know when. Anyway, when they are given, I will take yours too. So, don't forget to stop by sometime.

candidates.title: Karakas's ring
candidates.description: I received the ring of Karakass, which was available for sometime.

candidates.title: Sapha's Visit
candidates.description: There are rumors that a Sapha from Manuk has come to visit the camp. Aello trusts me so he appointed me to speak to him. The delegate is in the room at the right on the second floor.

candidates.title: Invitation from Sapha
candidates.description: Get permission from Avalanche, the General Guard at Manuk, to pass through the tunnel between Manuk and the Sapha's capital city El Dicastes.

candidates.title: To El Dicastes!
candidates.description: You have been approved from Avalanche to use the tunnel between Manuk and El Dicastes. I can finally go to the Capital of the Sapha! Find the Entrance Manager at the tunnel entrance in Manuk.

candidates.title: Inspector Doha
candidates.description: Before leaving for the Capital, Captain Hibba Agip told me to meet Inspector Doha. I don't know what it is for, but have to meet this Doha person before heading to Manuk. Doha is in the room next to Vyhannus'.

candidates.title: Secret Order from Doha - Investigation
candidates.description: Doha says that he's seeking the suspect of the stolen report case. He secretly orders you to collect information while in El Dicastes, explaining the suspect's outfit. The suspect is a guy with animal ears.

candidates.title: Secret Order from Doha - Shay
candidates.description: Shay is the manager of "Burman Flone", the Pub of El Dicastes. He suggested to obtain some information about "the guy with animal ears" from the Sapha who live in the capital.
candidates.goal: Converse with the Sapha in El Dicastes to gather information

candidates.title: Information Gathering - in the Plaza
candidates.description: Cat ears? Not Cat Hand Merchants? I have no idea. By the way have you met Ahat already? He is really beautiful and noble.

candidates.title: Information Gathering - in the Factory
candidates.description: A man with Cat ears? I've never heard of it. Do not try to find that kind of unreliable thing and just go to meet Ahat. He is real nice! He is the role model of Sapha!

candidates.title: Information Gathering - at the Guards
candidates.description: Cat ears? You sure? Are you humans always like that? Why don't you just go to meet Ahat. He is a very strong Sapha. He may be a Jarute working through piles of documents but he must be hiding his power!!

candidates.title: Shay's designation - BK
candidates.description: In order to facilitate information gathering, Shay introduced BK from the Cat Hand Merchants. You need to tell BK that ^4d4dff'Shay's special drink will be delivered.'^000000 if BK doesn't offer any help...
candidates.goal: Meet BK at the outskirts of Kamidal Mountain outside of El Dicastes

candidates.title: BK's Information
candidates.description: According to BK's information, the cat ears man is closely related to Ahat, the popular man in El Dicastes. But he says Ahat is not a Sapha and was found near the Crack. What's the relation?
candidates.goal: Discuss your findings with Shay at the Burman Flone

candidates.title: Dimensional Gap Investigation
candidates.description: After talking to Shay, investigate the dimensional gap area to the south to find the truth. Find any clues that may be useful to the investigation.
candidates.goal: Investigate the dimensional gap area to the south

candidates.title: What's this bloodstain?
candidates.description: I found blood clotted in the dirt near the crack. Does this have anything to do with Ahat?

candidates.title: What's this skin piece?
candidates.description: I found a frozen piece of skin from a living thing near the crack. Does this have anything to do with Ahat?

candidates.title: What's this suspicious magic power?
candidates.description: You found a suspicious magical stone fragment. It feels like the magic power from the crack. Does this have anything to do with Ahat?

candidates.title: Sapha Certifications?
candidates.description: It's unnecessary to bring Sapha Certifications to have an audience with Ahat. Carry out some quests you can find throughout the capital and collect them.

candidates.title: Audience with Ahat
candidates.description: You can have an audience with Ahat after paying 3 Sapha Certifications. You can meet Ahat after going up to the Administrative Office in Dicastes Diel.

candidates.title: Secret Order from Ahat
candidates.description: Ahat ordered you to remove various traces around the crack. Collect 10 items each of Clotted Bloodstain, Frozen Piece of Skin, and Strange Magic Stones.

candidates.title: Cheshire's call
candidates.description: Do the removal work bit by bit so that you don't arouse any suspicion. Meet with Cheshire at the Administrative Office when it is the proper time.
candidates.goal: Wait for the timer and speak to Cheshire

candidates.title: Removing traces
candidates.description: Remove traces from the Dimensional gap around the southeast area of the Kamidal mountain outskirts. As usual, collect 10 items of each of Clotted Bloodstain, Frozen Piece of Skin, and Strange Magic Stones.

candidates.title: Secret order from Doha - Collect proof
candidates.description: Without being noticed by Cheshire and Ahat, hide each crack trace to submit to Doha as evidence and put it in the report. Collect 1 Solid Bloodstain, 1 Frozen Skin Piece, and 1 Suspicious Magic Stone.

candidates.title: Secret order from Doha - Final Report
candidates.description: Talked with Jarute, Heslanta about several subjects. After talking with Heslanta bring your findings in a report to Doha at the Expedition camp.
candidates.goal: Bring your final Report to Inspector Doha

candidates.title: Spring Bringing Flower
candidates.description: I met "Bomi" in Lutie who was curious about Spring bringing flower. For her, I promised I would bring her a bunch of spring flower. It may be enough with 5 (Huge Spray Of Flowers)..
candidates.goal: Give Bomi Spring as a gift

candidates.title: The new days of Cheshire
candidates.description: You will find a member of the Cat Paw if you look in the middle of the ^4d4dffKamidal Tunnel^000000. ^4d4dff At West side of Skaraba Hall entrance there is a marked box of goods.^000000. Please move it. The location of where you need to move it will be on the box.

candidates.title: Cheshire's box
candidates.description: You found the box that Cheshire was talking about the Kamidal Tunnel. On the bottom side of the box in small letters, it says ^4d4dff In front of Bifrost's Crack^000000. Must pass this to Cheshire who can be anywhere in Bifrost.

candidates.title: And tomorrow, too, please?
candidates.description: Agreed to help transport the loaded box to Cheshire once a day to Kamidal Tunnel. When it is time, go get the box.

candidates.title: Forget the box
candidates.description: The box is lost. Instead of the box, Cheshire is asking you to get 20 Refined Bradium instead of the box.

candidates.title: Daily delivery
candidates.description: Cheshire is waiting for the Bradium box. You must take today's items to Cheshire who is waiting in Bifrost.

candidates.title: Explore the Foggy Forest
candidates.description: Explore the Foggy Forest. The foggy forest remembers you so if you try to force re-entry it may reject you.

candidates.title: Finding Loki
candidates.description: By chance, you met someone named Loki in the forest and is looking for someone. Jarani(name?) with the purple hair. What does this mean? If you discover should you let Loki know?

candidates.title: Wandering Protector
candidates.description: The thing that Loki was looking for was the Guardian of Niddhog who was wandering around the fog aimlessly. Once out of the forest, agreed to meet in Mora Village.

candidates.title: Advanced Training at Comodo
candidates.description: Look for the cave located to the north. There's someone there named Romeo. You know? As in Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo.

candidates.title: Stalactic Golem Hunt
candidates.description: There is a cave north of Comodo that has these big monsters there. It shouldn't be difficult to hunt 3 of them.

candidates.title: More Golem Hunting
candidates.description: Now that you've proven yourself, hunt 10 more Stalactic Golems so that travelers can travel safely through the cave then report to Romeo whos waiting in the field north of the Comodo Cave.

candidates.title: Field drops
candidates.description: Instructor Romeo asked you to bring him 5 Shoulder Protector and 7 Sharp Leaf from hunting Wootans and Dryads in the field north of the Comodo Cave.

candidates.title: Report to Instructor Ur
candidates.description: Your tasks for Step 1 are over for now so go back to Eden Group Headquarters and speak to Instructor Ur.

candidates.title: Advanced Training at Glast Heim
candidates.description: Near Geffen, there is an area known as Glast Heim infested with undead and ghost monsters. Find Johan at Glast Heim.

candidates.title: Wraith Hunt
candidates.description: Help clear out the Abbey by hunting the Wraiths inside.

candidates.title: Evil Druid hunt
candidates.description: Another problem monster in the Abbey is the Evil Druids. Hunt them inside the Abbey and return to Johan.

candidates.title: Report to Instructor Ur
candidates.description: Your hunting at Glast Heim has helped clear the Abbey. Go back to Eden Group Headquarters and speak to Instructor Ur.

candidates.title: Advaned Training in Einbroch
candidates.description: The industrial city of Einbroch east of Lighthalzen is where the next training mission is. Find the Dispatched Instructor Kiren at the field south of Einbroch.
candidates.goal: Find Kiren at south of Einbroch

candidates.title: Porcellio hunting
candidates.description: As a warm-up find and hunt 30 Porcellio monsters crawling around the fields of Einbroch.

candidates.title: Venomous hunting
candidates.description: There are gaseous green monsters known as Venomous that have been terrorizing the workers north of Einbroch.

candidates.title: Teddy Bear hunting
candidates.description: These Teddy Bears are not the cute cuddly things for kids. Hunt 5 of them quickly in the field north of Einbroch

candidates.title: Report to Instructor Ur
candidates.description: Your work at the Einbroch area is done. Go back to Eden Group Headquarters and speak to Instructor Ur.

candidates.title: Advanced Training in Ice Cave
candidates.description: There is an Ice Cave Cave if you travel North from Rachel. It's a long walk but it's worth it if you can make the trek. Find the Dispatched Instructor Naomi at the Ice Cave.
candidates.goal: Find Naomi at the Ice Cave

candidates.title: Siroma hunting
candidates.description: You can confuse these for giant balls of snow but they're actually monsters in disguise.

candidates.title: Hunting and Gathering
candidates.description: Now that you have a feel for it, hunt 30 more Siromas and bring back 30 Ice Cubic, 1 Sweet Sauce and 1 Milk.
candidates.goal: Hunt 30 Siroma and bring 30 Ice Cubic, 1 Sweet Sauce and 1 Milk to Naomi

candidates.title: Report to Instructor Ur
candidates.description: You are done hunting at Ice Cave. Go back to Eden Group Headquarters and speak to Instructor Ur.

candidates.title: Advanced Training at Ash Vacuum
candidates.description: Since you are a third class job, you should be able to fight the monsters at Ash Vacuum pretty easily. Find Margaret at the Midgard Expedition Camp.
candidates.goal: Find Margaret at the Midgard Expedition Camp

candidates.title: Margaret's favor
candidates.description: Margaret asked you to find the Dispatched Instructors Meeru and Mine. They're located at the fields just West and East of the Midgard Expedition Camp.
candidates.goal: Find Meeru and Mine and complete their quests and return to Margaret

candidates.title: Nepenthes Hunt
candidates.description: Meeru asked you to hunt 1 Nepenthes monster at Manuk Field and return to him.

candidates.title: Pinguicula Hunt
candidates.description: Mine asked you to hunt 5 Pinguicula monsters instead of him.

candidates.title: Report to Instructor Ur
candidates.description: Your training is done at Ash Vacuum. Go back to Eden Group Headquarters and speak to Instructor Ur.

candidates.title: Errands for Thorn (easy)
candidates.description: Thorn needs materials for refining so bring him 20 Iron Ore and 10 Iron.

candidates.title: Errands for Thorn (hard)
candidates.description: Thorn needs materials for refining so bring him 20 Used Iron Plate

candidates.title: Equipment Enhancement
candidates.description: Bring your new Eden Group Equipment to Thorn and ask him to strengthen them for you and he will give you a random equipment bonus.

candidates.title: Errands for Thorn timer
candidates.description: Return to Thorn after waiting 24 hours.

candidates.title: Play with the baby cat
candidates.description: The request from Rato, an expert cat sailor in Malangdo. He worries about the baby cats so asked you find them and play with them. Go to find those baby cats. They are Rosy the white one, Roku the black one, and gold one Charo.

candidates.title: Nyadventure-Duruduru Compass
candidates.description: You received Adventure card A from the baby cats who called themselved "Meow Bravery Team". The card seems necessary for operating some devices made by them. If you insert the card into the Beginning Compass, the game will start.

candidates.title: Nyadventure-Duruduru Race
candidates.description: Duruduru Compass Race has started. You have to finish the race in the correct order within a limited time. The order of the compass is (Red Flame) -> (Blue Flame) -> (Gold Flame) -> (Forest) -> (Cloud).

candidates.title: Nyadventure-Duruduru Race
candidates.description: Duruduru Compass Race has started. You have to finish the race in the correct order within a limited time. The order of the compass is (Gold Flame) -> (Blue Flame) -> (Cloud) -> (Forest) -> (Red Flame).

candidates.title: Nyadventure-I'm coming now.
candidates.description: Charo says that a detective cat is near ship Navi which is in the centre of Malangdo. Go to meet the detective and his friend.

candidates.title: Nyadventure-Stop the Bang!
candidates.description: Homnya, a doubtful cat who called himself a "real detective" and his friend Nyangson say that if the machine in front explodes, all of Malangdo will be destroyed. So they ask you to stop the machine.

candidates.title: Nyadventure-Bang! See you next time
candidates.description: According to Homnya and Nyangson, this machine named Bang causes a problem every minute. You never know when you will be in trouble. Check on the machine again tomorrow.

candidates.title: Nyadventure-Hidden Treasure?
candidates.description: When the Bang stopped, Homnya and Nyangson gives you a useful information. They talk about treasure something. Homnya says the treasure is inside of ship Navi. It might be just a joke but it is still worth to try.

candidates.title: Nyadventure-The First piece of Painting
candidates.description: The piece of Painting which you found in the box in ship Navi

candidates.title: Nyadventure-The Second piece of Painting
candidates.description: The piece of Painting which was put in the book in ship Navi's meeting room

candidates.title: Nyadventure-The Third piece of Painting
candidates.description: The piece of Painting which you found under the old bed in the crew's cabin

candidates.title: Nyadventure-The Fourth piece of Painting
candidates.description: The piece of Painting which you found in the decoration seashell of the captain's room

candidates.title: Nyadventure-The Fifth piece of Painting
candidates.description: The piece of Painting which you found in the crack of wooden pillar

candidates.title: Nyadventure-The Sixth piece of Painting
candidates.description: The piece of Painting which you found in the Ventilation window on the cabin floor

candidates.title: Nyadventure-Race, Come back tomorrow!
candidates.description: Duruduru Race is good if you only run once a day. If you want it, come back later.

candidates.title: Nyadventure-Painting completed
candidates.description: Pieces you found in the ship are over all 6. It seems a complete painting. Go to Charo, Rosy Roku and let them know this.

candidates.title: Gift from the Mew Bravery Team
candidates.description: Charo, Rosy and Roku say that they want to give Rato the painting pieces found. Bring the painting to Rato in order to deliver the love of baby cats (even though the painting is torn apart).

candidates.title: The origin of Bugs
candidates.description: Cleanyang's crying out loud saying that bugs appear over and over again although he cleans up the ship completely. Help him. Inspect ship Navi meticulously.

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Captain's Room
candidates.description: In the corner of the captain's room, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Crew's Cabin
candidates.description: In the sailor's room, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Meeting Room
candidates.description: In somewhere in the meeting room, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: To Chef Nyas
candidates.description: Cleanyang did clean up all the ship, but the problem was those cat's hard biscuit which were kept beyond his reach. You should tell Nyas the truth and clear Cleanyang of the false charge.

candidates.title: Rage of Chef Nyas
candidates.description: When you told the story about the biscuit and the bugs, the chef got so angry. You'd better talk with him a little later.

candidates.title: Declaration of Chef Nyas
candidates.description: Nyas decided himself and declared that at least one meal a day will be cat's hard biscuit from now. He asked you to bring 10 bags of Grain and 1 bottle of Savory sauce for making the biscuits.
candidates.goal: 10 bags of Grain, 1 bottle of Savory Sauce, Deliver the message to Cleanyang.

candidates.title: Appointed time with Cleanyang
candidates.description: In order to solve the Cat's hard biscuit incident, you are going to work with Cleanyang. Go back to Cleanyang at the appointed time.

candidates.title: Find the Cat's hard biscuits!
candidates.description: You are gonna pick up the biscuits which cats on the ship started to hide. If the biscuits are taken, the bugs also will be gone. Focus on the 9 spots where the biscuits are frequently seen.

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Rest Area
candidates.description: In the weed of outdoor rest area, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Sand area
candidates.description: In a strange pile of sand, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Under the stairs
candidates.description: In the corner underneath stairs, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Corner of Cat tower
candidates.description: In the corner of cat tower, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Corner of Locker
candidates.description: In the gap between the locker and the wall, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Foothold of Cat tower
candidates.description: In the gap between the foothold and the floor, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: Pick up Cat's Ship Biscuit-Sand Grave
candidates.description: In a sand grave, you found out cat's hard biscuit which was hidden. The biscuit was all covered with the bugs. Those bugs must be there for the biscuit..

candidates.title: Promise to deliver more food
candidates.description: Chef Nyas wants you to deliver the ingredient for the biscuit every day, and for some new food. Anyway go back to him whenever you can.

candidates.title: Errands List of Nyas
candidates.description: Chef Nyas ordered you to bring 10 Bags of Grain and 1 bottle of Savory Sauce. And he also wants you to get the food below for his curiosity of Human Food.
candidates.goal: 10 Bags of Grain, 1 Bottle of Savory Sauce, 1 Honey Grape Juice

candidates.title: Errands List of Nyas
candidates.description: Chef Nyas ordered you to bring 10 Bags of Grain and 1 bottle of Savory Sauce. And he also wants you to get the food below for his curiosity of Human Food.
candidates.goal: 10 Bags of Grain, 1 Bottle of Savory Sauce, 1 Chocolate Mousse Cake

candidates.description: You had too much takoyaki already. Why don't you take a break now?
candidates.goal: Wait for the time to expire before trying again

candidates.title: Cautious Village
candidates.description: First time in Port Malaya. Feeling a bit confused but better go see Phong in Mumbaki in the village as told. I'm sure he'll help me out.

candidates.title: Better than My Old Button
candidates.description: Villagers are trying to rip off my buttons and pulling on my sleeves. Let's distribute Holy Water and Blue Gemstones to them. That might keep them calm for a while.
candidates.goal: Deliver Holy Items to Pedro, Nardo, Pandoi, Woeon, Talah and Romel

candidates.title: Sailor Wants a Button
candidates.description: One of the villagers who wants an agimat to carry.

candidates.title: Why do they want my Buttons?
candidates.description: Cannot understand the villagers here. I'll have to ask Phong in Mumbaki why they are crazy over possessing buttons.
candidates.goal: Ask for advice from Phong in Mumbaki

candidates.title: Deliver Holy Item to Sailor
candidates.description: Better than nothing.

candidates.title: Deliver Holy Item to Old Man
candidates.description: Better than nothing.

candidates.title: Deliver Holy Item to Young Man
candidates.description: Better than nothing.

candidates.description: Better than nothing.

candidates.title: Better than My Old Button-2
candidates.description: Took Mumbaki Phong's advice and delivered holy items to villagers for them to carry as agimats. I'll have to talk with him again about what to do next.

candidates.title: Traditional Spiritual Protection and Impudent Girl-1
candidates.description: Mumbaki Phong's granddaughter, Imelda creates Traditional Spiritual Protections. Received a request to get materials to make these protections. Salt from the northwest shores, Bamboo from Baryo, and Silver Crosses from Pandoi.
candidates.goal: 6 Salt Bags, 6 Sharpened Bamboos, 6 Silver Crosses

candidates.title: Traditional Spiritual Protection and Impudent Girl-2
candidates.description: Wait for the girl to finish making the Spiritual Protections. It won't take too long. Maybe a cup of tea to defeat time...

candidates.title: Deliver Spiritual Protection-Pedro
candidates.description: Deliver the finished Spiritual Protection to Pedro, Sailor at the port.

candidates.title: Deliver Spiritual Protection-Nardo
candidates.description: Deliver the finished Spiritual Protection to Nardo, Old Man of the village.

candidates.title: Deliver Spiritual Protection-Pandoi
candidates.description: Deliver the finished Spiritual Protection to Pandoi, Cub Blacksmith.

candidates.title: Deliver Spiritual Protection-Woeon
candidates.description: Deliver the finished Spiritual Protection to Woeon, Collection Dealer.

candidates.title: Deliver Spiritual Protection-Talah
candidates.description: Deliver the finished Spiritual Protection to cute Talah.

candidates.title: Deliver Spiritual Protection-Romel
candidates.description: Deliver the finished Spiritual Protection to Talah's father, Romel.

candidates.title: Love and Spiritual Protection for All
candidates.description: Imelda asks you to deliver the finished Spiritual Protections to frightened villagers. Total of 6 villagers.

candidates.title: Love and Spiritual Protection Continues
candidates.description: The effect of the Spiritual Protection doesn't last so long. I'll help Imelda distribute the Spiritual Protections after a day.

candidates.title: Old Man and Cast-Iron Caldron-1
candidates.description: They say there is a small tribe called Baryo Mahiwaga outside of the Port Malaya city. Received a request to get Cast-Iron Caldrons from the monster called Bakonawa and distribute to those who want it.
candidates.goal: Deliver a Cast-Iron Caldron to Kiko in Mumbaki

candidates.title: Old Man and Cast-Iron Caldron-2
candidates.description: Delivered a Cast-Iron Caldron to Mumbaki Kiko in Baryo Mahiwaga and received a Spiritual Protection as a reward. Let's report back to Nardo to make this delivery official.

candidates.title: Old Man and Cast-Iron Caldron-Regular Trades
candidates.description: Cast-Iron Caldron is an item that is constantly pounded on so that it is always broken. That is why caldrons are procured regularly. Meet up with Nardo after a day. He will give you the delivery date for the Cast-Iron Caldron.

candidates.title: Peace Preacher
candidates.description: Delivered the Spiritual Protections to the 6 villagers according to Imelda's instructions. Feel like I've just participated in bringing peace and stability to this village. Let's share this great success with Imelda.

candidates.title: To Smith a Traditional Spiritual Protection
candidates.description: Promised to collect material to create Spiritual Protections. Salt can be collected from the northwest shores, Bamboo from Baryo, and Silver Crosses from Pandoi.
candidates.goal: 6 Salt Bags, 6 Sharpened Bamboos, 6 Silver Crosses

candidates.title: High Demand on Spiritual Protection Material
candidates.description: Spiritual Protections are always in need so materials are always depleted. Visit Imelda after a day. She'll definitely ask for more materials.

candidates.title: Deliver to Pedro
candidates.description: Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Pedro!

candidates.title: Deliver to Nardo
candidates.description: Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Nardo!

candidates.title: Deliver to Pandoi
candidates.description: Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Pandoi!

candidates.title: Deliver to Woeon
candidates.description: Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Woeon!

candidates.title: Deliver to Talah
candidates.description: Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Talah!

candidates.title: Deliver to Romel
candidates.description: Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Romel!

candidates.title: Maries's Child
candidates.description: Let's find the ^4d4dffInside-out Shirt^000000 for Maries's child who is lost in the woods. The shirt must be taken by an animal or a monster.

candidates.title: Give the Shirt to Maries's Child
candidates.description: Gave the shirt to Maries's child. The child will wear the shirt and go home safely. I'll have to let Maries know that everything is alright now.

candidates.title: Worried about Maries's Child
candidates.description: From the child's story, it looks like there is a mischievous spirit that fools people into losing their way. This mean the child might get lost again. If you are worried, stop by their place again.

candidates.title: Jejeling and Jejellopy
candidates.description: Collection Dealer, Woeon, collects Jejellopys and asked you to help collect them. Hunt down Jejelings nearby and collect the Jejellopys they drop. Deliver 30 Jejellopys to Woeon.

candidates.title: Collect Jejellopy Regularly
candidates.description: Jejellopy is manufactured to use as material in various products. Woeon will need as many Jejellopys as he can get. Let's visit him when I have spare time.

candidates.title: Shiny Silver Blade
candidates.description: Cub Blacksmith, Pandoi's dream is to make a Silver Blade weapon. Collect 10 Silver Bracelets from monsters in the hospital.
candidates.goal: 10 Silver Bracelets, and defeat Manananggal and Tiyanak

candidates.title: Shiny Tomorrow
candidates.description: Go back to Pandoi after a day. If he failed to create a Silver Blade, then he will need your help to get more Silver Bracelets.

candidates.title: Ghost on the Perry Ship
candidates.description: Decided to see for yourself if Pedro's story that the Perry Ship is haunted is true. Ghosts around here seem to be afraid of me so let's not be afraid to board the ship.

candidates.title: Angry Soul on Perry Ship
candidates.description: Was treated badly in the Perry Ship by an angry girl spirit. Let's look for a solution.

candidates.title: Mumbaki Phong's Advice
candidates.description: Mumbaki Phong said not to avoid the spirit but to embrace and soothe it. Let's look for flowers to offer. You can get flowers from the animals and monsters nearby.
candidates.goal: 3 Elegant Flowers, 3 Mysterious Flowers, 3 Beautiful Flowers

candidates.title: Offering Bouquet Recommended by Mumbaki
candidates.description: Mumbaki Phong blessed the flowers and made an Offering Bouquet you've brought to him. Let's take this bouquet to Soul Diwata on the Perry Ship.

candidates.title: Soul Diwata's Story
candidates.description: Diwata said she was bullied by native ghosts because she was from outside of the village. Perry Ship is stuck because Diwata's powerful soul.

candidates.title: All Aboard for Perry Sailing
candidates.description: Looks like the Perry Ship can operate regularly for the time being. But let's check up on the ship after a day. There still is a chance of native ghosts bullying Diwata.

candidates.title: Bouquet for Diwata
candidates.description: Decided to create a bouquet to calm Diwata from her fight with the native ghosts. Gather flowers for Mumbaki Phong to bless.
candidates.goal: 3 Elegant Flowers, 3 Mysterious Flowers, 3 Beautiful Flowers

candidates.title: Stabilized Perry
candidates.description: Diwata calmed down after receiving the bouquet. The Perry Ship can start sailing again. Let's tell Pedro.

candidates.title: Get Rid of Jejeling
candidates.description: Decided to help some peddlers traveling to and from Baryo to defeat Jejelings. Try to get rid of 20 Jejelings today.

candidates.title: Get Rid of Jejeling - Same Time Tomorrow
candidates.description: Getting rid of Jejelings is an ongoing project that needs lots of help. To participate, meet the Guard after a day.

candidates.title: Agree to Collecting Bones!
candidates.description: Collect bones for the guard dog Vantai. Collected bones must be purified. Take the collected Evil Spirit Bones to Mumbaki Kiko to purify them.

candidates.title: Purified Bone
candidates.description: Received Purified Spirit Bones after Mumbaki Kiko's ritual. Let's take them to Quarter.
candidates.goal: Deliver 10 Purified Spirit Bones to Quarter10

candidates.title: Agree to Come Back Tomorrow?
candidates.description: Guard Quarter of Baryo Mahiwaga would like to have more bones to give Vantai tomorrow. Let's visit again after a day.

candidates.title: Cannot Meet Eyes with Him!
candidates.description: Self-claimed Good Capre Budidai cannot bear to see his friends being bullied by the Bungisngis. Bungisngis was too powerful for Budidai to handle and now he is asking if you can help him take care of the one-eyed monster.

candidates.title: Teach Another Lesson Tomorrow!
candidates.description: Capre Budidai said the Bongisungisu won't go away from one scare and asks to continue threatening them. Come back after a day.

candidates.title: The traveler, Fome's story
candidates.description: Listened to the story regarding the Lapines and Eclage.

candidates.title: The traveler, Litrip's story
candidates.description: Listened to the story regarding Bifrost Tower.

candidates.title: The traveler, Chiba's story
candidates.description: Listened to the Lapines' organization and roles.

candidates.title: Eclage guard's message
candidates.description: Someone from Eclage wanted to meet. Ask for directions from the guard near the east exit of the Eclage plaza.
candidates.goal: Talking with the guard at the east exit of Eclage

candidates.title: Lapine's Chief of Staff
candidates.description: Planned to meet someone based on the instructions from the Eclage guard. If lost, ask for directions from the guard again.
candidates.goal: Talking with the chief of staff

candidates.title: Waiting to meet
candidates.description: After talking with the chief of staff, requested to meet with King of Lapines Mayor Jun. Once the wait is over, let's ask the Eclage guard again for more directions.

candidates.title: Kardui's request
candidates.description: Mayor Jun did not listen to my sincere stories, but instead stated that he would listen to more of it if I were to contribute to Eclage more significantly. Let's take care of the Lapines in Eclage that need help.

candidates.title: For Eclage 1
candidates.description: Obtain ingredients to decorate Yai for the Eclage guard who is too busy. Horns of Hillslion, Mystic Horns, Horse's Hooves, 5 of each, would be sufficient.
candidates.goal: 5 Horns of Hillslion, 5 Mystic Horns, 5 Horse's Hooves

candidates.title: For Eclage 2
candidates.description: Decided to deliver mails from Splendide Contact Officer as a favor for Roy the messenger who was having trouble at the edge of Bifrost due to communications getting cut off.

candidates.title: For Eclage 3
candidates.description: For Leo who loves sweets, get him Splendide-made Pinguicula's Pickled Fruits and Luciola's Honey Jam. Pickled fruits and honey jam can be obtained using coins at the advanced base.
candidates.goal: 3 Pinguicula's Pickled Fruits, 3 Luciola's Honey Jam

candidates.title: That's enough
candidates.description: While working on various jobs, Kardui's page reached me. Must go and meet Kardui. His office will be on the top floor when following the spiral road.

candidates.title: Kardui's gift
candidates.description: Kardui stated that he prepared a gift that can be picked up from Chief of Staff Shenime. What could it be..

candidates.title: A rumor about the King 1
candidates.description: During the conversation with Leo, unsettling things about Kardui were told. He didn't seem to get into the details but it was very concerning.

candidates.title: A rumor about the King 2
candidates.description: Fome shared something unexpected. It was that Lapines have been subtly disliking Kardui. This was similar to what Leo seemed to keep to himself before.

candidates.title: A rumor about the King 3
candidates.description: Connection between Cenes's despotism and Kardui was made through talking with the Lapines. It is not too serious, but it is certain that the current king Kardui is being considered in a way similar to how Cenes was.

candidates.title: A rumor about the King 4
candidates.description: Most recently, Kardui seemed to have become Mayor Jun in the midst of the calamity facing the entire Lapine race. They don't seem to completely disagree with his policies, but they don't seem to agree with them either.

candidates.title: At times like this, face it straight on!
candidates.description: The truth behind Lapine's anxiety and fear toward Kardui could no longer be elucidated. Shouldn't this at least be communicated to the individual of interest? It might be possible to hear about the reason behind it all..

candidates.title: Yai of the wild
candidates.description: Obtain items for the Yai for the Eclage guard Minuel who stands post every day and night.
candidates.goal: 10 Horns of Hillslion, 10 Mystic Horns, 10 Horse Hooves

candidates.title: Wild recent trend!
candidates.description: The items collected by Minuel seemed to have created a sensation among the Yai decorations. Let's obtain the times regularly to keep the trend going.
candidates.goal: Check with Minuel after some time

candidates.title: Deliveryman that runs through space
candidates.description: Delivered mails from Splendide in place of Roy who is still having trouble at the edge of Bifrost.

candidates.title: A mailman never rests!
candidates.description: Mails require regular deliveries. Let's check again later.
candidates.goal: Check with Roy after some time

candidates.title: The troublemakers in the land of blooming flowers
candidates.description: Let's show who's boss to Menblatt and Petals that annoy travelers. It's reported as patrolling, but it's actually elimination.

candidates.title: Need constant guidance
candidates.description: Leo once again asks to patrol and subjugate the Menblatt and Petals. Let's check with him later.
candidates.goal: Check with Leo after some time

candidates.title: Kardui's big brother
candidates.description: Kardui sends a letter to his big brother. Kardui's brother lives on the top flower of Biforst Tower. Let's deliver it to him.

candidates.title: Time for reading the letter
candidates.description: Hisie asked for some time to read the letter. It only takes a couple of minutes, so let's wait a bit.
candidates.goal: Wait until he is done reading the letter

candidates.title: Avant the Scholar of Magics
candidates.description: In Kardui's letter, there was not only an introduction but also a request to look for his father, Avant the Scholar of Magics. Help Hisie to find out more about the scholar from within Eclage.

candidates.title: Shenime's favor
candidates.description: Could not obtain Avant's info but instead got a strange request from Shenime. Asked to gather experimental ingredients for the scholar of magics he sponsors. They are 10 Dust Balls, 10 Leaf Bookmarks.

candidates.title: Secret sponsorship
candidates.description: Shenime did not share even a bit about the scholar of magics he sponsors, and asks to forget about even finding out about it. Is there anyone that knows?

candidates.title: The scholar of magics sponsored by Shenime
candidates.description: Hisie stated that if you track down Shenime, the location of the scholar might be identified as well. Find out Shenime's duties.

candidates.title: Minuel's witness
candidates.description: Eclage guard Minuel stated that Shenime often travels east, in the opposite direction from his Yai. Discuss with Hisie.

candidates.title: Mail is here!
candidates.description: Planned to visit the scholar of magic's Yai as if Shenime is sending a mail. Hisie will confirm whether that person is Avant. Hisie will provide the information at the crossroads in front of Eclage.

candidates.title: The identity of the scholar of magics
candidates.description: The scholar of magics found through the strategy was indeed Avant. Must tell this to Kardui.

candidates.title: Interfere with the research!
candidates.description: A small revenge. Kardui and Hisie want to know what Avant is researching and want to interfere it. Could this be a small revenge of the brothers?

candidates.title: What Avant was researching
candidates.description: Avant was researching on the methods to extract the Orb's magic power. Since this is dangerous information, the research materials should immediately be returned to Kardui.
candidates.goal: Deliver the research materials to Kardui

candidates.title: Avant's back
candidates.description: Researched the force behind Avant's research on the Orb. The most likely culpril is Avant's sponsor, the chief of staff. Approach the chief of staff to reveal the truth.
candidates.goal: Talk with the chief of staff

candidates.title: Unfruitful conversation
candidates.description: Talked with Shenime the chief of staff, but nothing was gained. He states that he might also have been tricked by Avant. The chief of staff was actually upset that Kardui only increased the defenses surrounding the Orb.

candidates.title: Dilemma surrounding the Orb
candidates.description: Only confirmed the distrust toward Kardui's instead of revealing more about Avant's research. The chief of staff hoped that Kardui's judgment has not weakened, and asked that he would demonstrate it.

candidates.title: Something's not right
candidates.description: After discussing with Kardui and Hisie, it is decided that the chief of staff is indeed the most suspicious. What is the reason behind his resistance toward Kardui's actions toward the Orb?
candidates.goal: Surveillance of the chief of staff

candidates.title: Temptation toward the Orb
candidates.description: The chief of staff asked to go to the Orb's lighting room to discuss it. I decided to let Kardui know about this after telling him to give me some time to think about it.

candidates.title: Orb's lighting room
candidates.description: Not sure why the chief of staff kept trying to lure me into the Orb's lighting room, but decided to go there even just to figure out why. Let's go along with what he wants for now.
candidates.goal: Hold hands with the chief of staff

candidates.title: Betrayal
candidates.description: Everything is so confusing. The monster battled in the lighting room was not a subordinate of the King of Demons. They controlled me without my knowledge. Shenime the chief of staff betrayed all!

candidates.title: Find the chief of staff!
candidates.description: Shenime the chief of staff, who was responsible for all these occurrences, has hidden his whereabouts. According to Hisie's sources, residual magic force was faintly felt in Bifrost.

candidates.title: The last of the chief of staff
candidates.description: The road from the north to the south in Bifrost. It used to be an open path but is currently blocked by a huge rift in the south. On the way to the rift, the chief of staff's corpse was found.

candidates.title: Return of Rayan Moore
candidates.description: The dimensional gap was found based on the information from Rayan Moore. Find out how he's doing while he's being held captive in Eclage.

candidates.title: Dimension Traveller
candidates.description: The dimensional devices are specially manufactured to enter the dimensional gap between space and time.

candidates.title: Explore the tower
candidates.description: You've been asked to explore the Thanatos Tower through the dimensional gap.

candidates.title: Treat the injured
candidates.description: Treat the wounded soldiers with the first-aid kits.

candidates.title: Destroy the demons!
candidates.description: Demons are invading from the upper floor. Get rid of the Evil Shadows that are invading there will be 7 of each kind to destroy.

candidates.title: Tower Expedition
candidates.description: The tower was built by a demon tribe headed by one named Thanatos during a war between gods and demons. It was activated by Satan Morocc in an attempt to re-enter Rune Midgard

candidates.title: Lucile...?
candidates.description: Lucile, a mysterious girl in the Demon's Tower asked to help recover her body.

candidates.title: Magic Swordman Thanatos
candidates.description: Magic swordman Thanatos has to prevent the Magic Seals of the demon from approaching to successfully seal the Satan Morocc.
candidates.goal: Get rid of the Magic Seals

candidates.title: Thanatos Tower
candidates.description: It is called Thanatos Tower because it is where the magic swordsman sealed the power of Satan Morocc hundreds of years ago.

candidates.title: Evil followers
candidates.description: Destroy the Evil Followers

candidates.title: Morocc castle seal
candidates.description: Years from now, someone will try to awaken Satan Morocc in Morocc castle since Thanatos Tower is sealed.

candidates.title: Space distortion
candidates.description: Exploring time and space causes your body to be in flux. You need to take a break or you will lose your mind.
candidates.goal: Wait for the timer before re-entering

candidates.title: Rampaging Box
candidates.description: The Flame Basin is overrun with animated boxes with hostile intent. Subjugate the boxes and identify them.

candidates.title: Collecting Bradiums
candidates.description: Those rampaging boxes are enchanted Bradium Boxes. Subjugate the boxes and collect Bradium Boxes.

candidates.title: Collecting Every Day
candidates.description: You've decided to collect Bradium Boxes every day to try to thwart Chesher's scheme. Come back to Hasranta tomorrow.

candidates.title: Eliminating Risks
candidates.description: Morocc Fire Vassal, Morocc Twisted Vassal, and Morocc Cold Vassal are the biggest threat to our subjugation operation. Please take care of them.

candidates.title: Daily Cleaning
candidates.description: Leave them to other subjugators for now. You deserve a rest.

candidates.title: Collecting Mana
candidates.description: Lapine Magic Scholar Avant has asked you to collect Mana Crystallines from those abnormally strong Demons. This quest can be performed with the Alliance quest, Eliminating Risks.

candidates.title: Unending Battle
candidates.description: The Demons are siphoning off the mana to maintain their strength. You've decided to come back to Avant every day, to help him collect Mana Crystallines.

candidates.title: Demon God Subjugation
candidates.description: It's time to finish the job: defeat Morroc in the Temple of the Demon God.

candidates.title: Frost Spider and Fire Wolf
candidates.description: Defeat Morroc's creations and his followers: Frost Spider Brinaranea and Fire Wolf Muspellskoll.

candidates.title: Wandering Orb Magic
candidates.description: Collect the mana stolen from Yggdrasil and the Orb: hit and scatter Brilliant Manas, Life Manas, and Earth Manas.

candidates.title: Qualifications of the Guests
candidates.description: To enter the Temple of the Demon God, you need a key. Defeat Gatekeeper Ahat and Shnaim, and use their souls to open the temple entrance.

candidates.title: Fall of the False God
candidates.description: You defeated Demon God Morroc, who wanted to create a new world and play God. Report to Commander Hiva Agip.

candidates.title: Caged God
candidates.description: Confined in his own world, the Demon God is cursed to suffer for eternity. Come back tomorrow and put him out of his misery once more.

candidates.title: Unending Hunt
candidates.description: The hunting continues until every single Demon in the Temple of the Demon God is defeatd. Adjutant Abidal asked you to come back when you are fully rested.

candidates.title: Promising Tomorrow
candidates.description: The Orb of Eclage and Yggdrasil have lost a substantial amount of mana, and thus the mana collection work continues until most of it is retrieved. Take a rest and come back to Hishieh before you move on to the Temple of the Demon God.

candidates.title: Temple of the Demon God Phase 1
candidates.description: Defeat Frost Spider Brinaranea to move on to the next area.

candidates.title: Temple of the Demon God Phase 1 Completed
candidates.description: You defeated Frost Spider Brinaranea.

candidates.title: Temple of the Demon God Phase 2
candidates.description: Defeat Fire Wolf Muspellskoll to move on to the next area.

candidates.title: Temple of the Demon God Phase 2 Completed
candidates.description: You defeated Fire Wolf Muspellskoll.

candidates.goal: Talk with Lime in the employee office

candidates.title: Atnad Excavation Team - s2

candidates.description: You are now an official member of the Atnad Excavation Team, and can participate in the Phantasmagorika excavation project.
