candidates.description: Could you help us take care of monsters in the tunnel and around here? When you done report to Commander Louis

candidates.title: Passage Cleaning - standby
candidates.description: You should take rest. Our mercenaries can take care of the monsters in the passage. You can take quest again from Commander Louis

candidates.title: Eliminating Risks
candidates.description: Robots in the main excavation site are getting in our way. Please get rid of them.

candidates.title: Eliminating Risks - standby
candidates.description: We're able to clear the excavation site of those robots. Please come back next time.

candidates.title: Core Collection
candidates.description: Please collect 20 Power Control Devices from robots. They can be the key to the highly advanced civilization.

candidates.title: Core Collection - standby
candidates.description: The Atnad Excavation Team is focusing on studying the Power Control Devices. You should take rest while you can.

candidates.title: Turning In Excavation Report
candidates.description: Take the Atnad Excavation Team's daily excavation report to Louis at the Central Command Center. After that your work for the day is done!
candidates.goal: Turn in the report to Louis

candidates.title: Reporting the Results - standby
candidates.description: Wait for The Atnad Excavation Team's next report.

candidates.title: Assisting the Excavation Team
candidates.description: You are now an official member of the excavation team. Go to Aureth.

candidates.title: Young Blood?
candidates.description: Aureth has asked you to go to Lloyd and Luke at the plaza in the middle of Verus.

candidates.title: Bottling the Energy
candidates.description: Lloyd has asked for your assistance in his energy research. Use ^4d4dffEmpty Bottles^000000 to collect 10 Condensed Energies from debris everywhere in Verus.

candidates.title: Good News!
candidates.description: Report Aureth with Lloyd's research results.

candidates.title: Atnad's Summon
candidates.description: The Atnad Excavation Team has some chore in store for you. Talk with him.

candidates.title: In Search of a Delicacy
candidates.description: Find something that is ready to eat, juicy, refreshing, and clean-tasting. Seek advice from other team members.

candidates.title: Count On Me
candidates.description: Luke will cook something for you if you can bring 2 Meats, 1 Mora Mandarin, and 1 Banana.

candidates.title: Delicacy for Him
candidates.description: Take Luke's Beef Toast, Mora's specialty food, to Atnad.

candidates.title: Last Exploration
candidates.description: Ask Ian Atnad about his last exploration effort.

candidates.title: New Power Source
candidates.description: You are charged with collecting Condensed Energies for Lloyd's research. You need 10 Empty Bottles.

candidates.title: Tomorrow for Tomorrow's Energy
candidates.description: Return to Lloyd tomorrow to continue to help him with his research.

candidates.title: Legenday Blue Unicorn
candidates.description: Rumor says there is a blue pony raging in the forest near Payon! Someone help me find the truth about this animal!
candidates.goal: Hunt and report back to Fury

candidates.title: Hunting Limit
candidates.description: Please wait at least 23 hours before hunting again. But try not to hunt more than once a day!

candidates.title: Access Permitted
candidates.description: Access approved for restricted areas "Laboratories" and "Research Facilities". Free access to laboratories and research facilities is possible from now on.

candidates.title: Explore Research facilities
candidates.description: Look around and search for things of special investigation and research value in the Research facilities area. Report even small but significant things to Ian Atnad

candidates.title: Mysterious Piece
candidates.description: Found some kind of component in the Research facilities. Report to Ian Atnad.

candidates.title: Record Player
candidates.description: Record player is needed to know the contents of Memory Record. Commander Arquien of the Paradise Squad knows the whereabouts of the record player.

candidates.title: Piece of Memory Record
candidates.description: At least 5 pieces are needed to play Memory Record intact. Collect the rest of the Memory Records in the Research facilities and take them to Commander Arquien who came to the Verus excavation site.

candidates.title: Play Memory Record
candidates.description: Converse with Commander Arquien after playing Memory Record

candidates.title: Report Memory Record
candidates.description: Report to Ian Atnad about what you found out about the Memory Records

candidates.title: Memory Records of the Laboratories
candidates.description: Collect 5 "Memory Records of the laboratories" in the underground facility of the laboratories and take them to Arquien to find out the content.

candidates.title: Report Memory Record Content
candidates.description: Report to Ian Atnad about the content known from the Memory Records of laboratories

candidates.title: Collect Memory Records of Research facilities
candidates.description: Collect 5 Memory Records in the research facilities and take them to Arquien to decipher the content

candidates.title: One Memory a Day
candidates.description: Collect Memory Records only once a day. Go to Arquien at the promised time.

candidates.title: Collect Memory Records of Laboratories
candidates.description: Collect 5 Memory Records in the laboratories and take them to Arquien to decipher the content

candidates.title: One Memory a Day 2
candidates.description: Collect Memory Records in the laboratories only once a day. Go to Arquien at the promised time.

candidates.title: Play Research facilities Memory Records
candidates.description: Find out content by playing record player.

candidates.title: Play Laboratories Memory Records
candidates.description: Find out content by playing record player.

candidates.title: Invitation of Rekenber
candidates.description: Rekenber has invited you to the corporate headquarters. Visit Rekenber Corporation Headquarters located in Rihrtarzen.

candidates.title: Find my Lost lamb
candidates.description: Use the ^4d4dffHunting Rope^000000 on to ^4d4dffLost Lambs^000000 wandering Rune Midgard.

candidates.title: The lambs keep running away
candidates.description: The guard dog seems to be scaring the lambs away regularly. Come back after a few hours and Bori will likely have lost more lambs.
candidates.goal: Return to Bori after the timer has expired

candidates.title: Invitation to Royal Banquet
candidates.description: A banquet is held at the Prontera Palace to honor the sacrifice made by those who went on with the expedition mission in Ash-Bakum to defeat atrocious Morocc and praise their dedication. All of you are invited to this banquet.

candidates.title: Socializing Starts from an Eye Contact
candidates.description: Visit the seven royal families to exchange greetings. There are the Heine, Nerius and Walther families in the West Villa, and there are the Richard, Wigner, Roegenburg and Geoborg families in the East Villa.

candidates.title: Visit the Heines
candidates.description: You visited the Heines to exchange greetings.

candidates.title: Visit the Nerius
candidates.description: You visited the Nerius to exchange greetings.

candidates.title: What Is the Next Thing on the Schedule ?
candidates.description: You have completed everything on the schedule. Ask Chamberlain Bell in your room about the next thing on the schedule.

candidates.title: Nyhill and Skia
candidates.description: You witnessed the conversation between Nyhill and Skia in the hallway.

candidates.title: Participating in the Banquet
candidates.description: Belle asked you to participate in the banquet since you had some time to spare. You were told that Spica the lady of the Nerius family wanted to meet you.

candidates.title: Suspicious Movement
candidates.description: While moving to take part in the banquet, you heard about the conversation between the strangers in the guest room.

candidates.title: Find Nyhill
candidates.description: Skia felt that Nyhill wasn't walking straight. Skia asked you to follow Nyhill who left the banquet early.

candidates.title: Where Is Nyhill?
candidates.description: When you were looking for Nyhill, you eavesdropped on a suspicious conversation. Where is Nyhill?

candidates.title: Waiting for the Ritual
candidates.description: Go back to the room to talk with Belle. A magician was supposed to come for the ritual...

candidates.title: Attend the Ritual
candidates.description: Participate in the ritual following the lead of the magician.

candidates.title: Surprise Attack
candidates.description: A surprise attack was casted during the ritual!

candidates.title: I'd Like to See that Too
candidates.description: After everyone leaves, let's take a look at the royal document which Kronecker was looking at

candidates.title: Escape from the Past Memories of the Royal Family
candidates.description: You need to get out of the place through the emergency exit instead of the gate which doesn't work. The knight guarding in front of the door may guide you.

candidates.title: What's Next?
candidates.description: I don't know what to do now. Let's ask Belle.

candidates.title: Invitation from the Nerius
candidates.description: You have been invited to the Nerius family. Let's go visit the Nerius.

candidates.title: Heine Now
candidates.description: While talking to the Nerius, the request to visit the Heines has arrived.

candidates.title: To the Past
candidates.description: You have been asked to visit the Past Memories of the Royal Family with Nillem by connecting the gaps in the dimension. Where is Nillem?

candidates.title: Once More!
candidates.description: Move once more through the gap in the dimension which Nillem has twisted by force. What happened in the Room of Consciousness in the past?

candidates.title: Lost Imir Heart
candidates.description: Check what had happened to the actual Imir Heart in the Room of Consciousness.

candidates.title: Prontera at the Time
candidates.description: Prontera has been attacked by the Undead before, and it is taking place right now. You have decided to go out there after a persistent persuasion by Nillem.

candidates.title: Who Knows the Truth
candidates.description: It is the time to go back to the present time, unseal the document and find out about the truth. Everything lies in the Past Memories of the Royal Family.

candidates.title: Unchangeable Past
candidates.description: I couldn't save the Imir Heart infringed by Valkyrie today either.

candidates.title: Hope You Cannot Let Go
candidates.description: You are not sure whether it would work or not, but you are asked to challenge again in the Room of Consciousness. Defeat Bijou and defend the piece of Imir Heart.
candidates.goal: Room of Consciousness in the Past

candidates.title: Nillem Is Not Almighty
candidates.description: Multiple connection is a difficult thing even for Nillem. I think there is a certain limit to connect to the Room of Consciousness. Let's wait for Nillem's recovery.

candidates.title: Beginning
candidates.description: Yo Ho! I am a fabulous Doram from Pa~sta! I've climbed Laviol mountain, came to Lasagna port. And I'm going to take over the new continent Midgard!

candidates.title: Where am I? Who am I??
candidates.description: Yo Ho! I am a fabulous Doram from Pa~sta! Road to Port town Lasagna, a Militiaman Alio can tell you more.

candidates.title: First Battle!
candidates.description: I knew it. Militiaman Alio wants to check my ability. An eggring is nothing with my foot punch!

candidates.title: Refreshing Apple Juice
candidates.description: There's nothing like sweet and cold drink after work. Militiaman Alio seems to understand.

candidates.title: Midding Box
candidates.description: A kid from town is saying he lost a delivery box. A Doram's duty is to help the kid! Let's hunt Eggrings to find the box.

candidates.title: To the Village!
candidates.description: Took back the box from eggring. Militiaman Alio wants me to deliver this to the kid in the Lasagna tool shop. Indeed, delievery is an adventure!

candidates.title: Merchant's Kindness
candidates.description: Toolshop owner gave me some useful items, asks me to find ^4d4dffHaru the Healer^000000. Healer lives in ^4d4dffthe house full of flowerpot, east from the toolshop^000000.

candidates.title: I'm used to this
candidates.description: Move to the meadow near the village, work on ^4d4dffRed Grass^000000 and come back with ^4d4dff1 Red Herb^000000. It's needed for the medicine, so let's get moving.

candidates.title: Time to Digest
candidates.description: To help the cat in front of Lasagna village lets do some labor. Work on ^4d4dffRed Grass and collect 2 Red Herbs^000000. Piece of cake!

candidates.title: Service Manual
candidates.description: Learned a lot about how to use the warehouse, and location saving service as well.

candidates.title: Cat showoff contest
candidates.description: A bet has started! To win hunt down 3 Lunatics and 2 Fabres the fastest. Lunatics and Fabres seems to live nearby.
candidates.goal: You have 10 minutes to hunt the following:

candidates.title: EMT
candidates.description: Learned emergency medical treatment.

candidates.title: The potential within
candidates.description: Learned about status and ability. Let's talk with Militiaman Nyoki more about this.

candidates.title: Full of Spring Energy
candidates.description: 아를르는 프론테라 꽃나무 근처에 어린 ^4d4dff꽃나무의 기운^000000을 풀어주고, ^4d4dff꽃가지^000000 10개를 구해달라고 의뢰했다.

candidates.title: Sleepless night, Cries of Spirit beyond the sea
candidates.description: Akarin suffer sleepless night everyday because of unknown cries. I think it's because of Banshee.

candidates.title: Please purify the Sanctuary!
candidates.description: Eridanus whose working in temple said there are strange noises came from underground of temple. It must be evil creatures ^4d4dffHodremlin, Vanberk and Isilla^000000, please defeat them.

candidates.title: It's obviously a ghost!
candidates.description: Rigel in Kiel Hyre academy heard strange noises that came from the waste cathedral, has requested an investigation. Let's check the cathedral.

candidates.title: In depth investigation
candidates.description: Waste cathedral interior consisted of complex facilities. Enter the 2nd floor and defeat elliot then retrive ^4d4dff1 piece of Burned part^000000.

candidates.title: Suspicious tunnel
candidates.description: Ayla found a way to enter facility through underground tunnel.

candidates.title: Suspicious Sign
candidates.description: The Elders of Payon are worried about the apprentice Soul Linker, Muyeon, who disappeared during a ritual. I should talk with the young scholar at the entrance to the Payon Cave.

candidates.title: What Happened?
candidates.description: Muyeon left for the detached palace. The young scholar wants to ask her what happened.

candidates.title: What Muyeon Saw
candidates.description: Muyeon is agitated by something she saw during the purging ritual. She said I should see it for myself.

candidates.title: Distressing Ritual
candidates.description: Muyeon says she could let me have a first-hand experience of the purging ritual. I'd better brace myself and talk with her.

candidates.title: Nightmare in the Ruined Village
candidates.description: I blacked out during the ritual and arrived at the ruined village inside Payon Cave. Is this shimmering portal in front of me connected to the nightmare that Muyeon told me about?

candidates.title: Nightmare in the Ruined Village
candidates.description: The young scholar was sucked into the shimmering portal in the ruined village inside the Payon Cave.
candidates.goal: Talk with Chunghae on the other side of the portal

candidates.title: Stop the Wizard!
candidates.description: Scholar Chunghae in the Nightmare of the Moonlight Flower dungeon thinks the ^4d4dffWizard of the Truth^000000 is responsible for this incident. He asked me to take care of him.

candidates.title: Stop the Wizard! - Pending
candidates.description: You can re-receive this Daily quest from Scholar Chunghae in the Nightmare of the Moonlight Flower dungeon after it cools down.

candidates.title: No Mercy for Illusions
candidates.description: Soldier Junghee in the Nightmare of the Moonlight Flower dungeon asked me to clear the area around him of ^4d4dffAngry Nine Tails^000000.

candidates.title: No Mercy for Illusions - Pending
candidates.description: You can re-receive this Daily quest from Soldier Junghee in the Nightmare of the Moonlight Flower dungeon after it cools down.

candidates.title: Remembering My Ancestors
candidates.description: Soldier Junghee in the Nightmare of the Moonlight Flower dungeon asked me to send ^4d4dffResentful Soldiers^000000 to Heaven.

candidates.title: Remembering My Ancestors - Pending
candidates.description: You can re-receive this Daily quest from Soldier Junghee in the Nightmare of the Moonlight Flower dungeon after it cools down.

candidates.title: Back to Muyeon
candidates.description: Relay Chunghae's investigation results to ^4d4dffMuyeon^000000 in the ^4d4dffDetached Payon Palace^000000.
candidates.goal: Talk with Muyeon in the Detached Palace

candidates.title: Rock Ridge, Land of Opportunities
candidates.description: Karam Pucci has waived the ship fare to Rock Ridge as a complimentary service.

candidates.title: Problems in Rock Ridge
candidates.description: Karam Pucci said Rock Ridge needs help. I should go to Rock Ridge and talk with Mayor Costello by the dock.

candidates.title: Problems in Rock Ridge 2
candidates.description: Mayor Costello said Rock Ridge is in trouble because of the Buffalo Bandits, and that he wants me to solve the problem in concert with the sheriff. ^4d4dffI should go to the sheriff's office and meet Wyatt Warp^000000.

candidates.title: Good News
candidates.description: Johnny James, the leader of the Buffalo Bandits, only wants to negotiate with Mayor Costello. I should deliver this exciting news to ^4d4dffCostello at the dock^000000.

candidates.title: Expected Response
candidates.description: Costello, too afraid of the bandits to go negotiate with them, asked me to go on his behalf. I should go tell Sheriff Warp.

candidates.title: Negotiation on the Railroad
candidates.description: The negotiation meeting will take place by the ^4d4dffunmoving freight train^000000. I can find it if I exit the village through the eastern gate and follow the railroad.

candidates.title: Unexpected Arrest
candidates.description: Cactus vigilantes have helped us capture the leader of the Buffalo Bandits, Johnny James. I should return to the ^4d4dffsheriff's office and talk with the sheriffs about our next move^000000.

candidates.title: Hear Me Out 1
candidates.description: Like Ivoka suggested, I should talk with Johnny James and plant a seed of doubt in his mind about Albert Ford.

candidates.title: Perfectly Primed
candidates.description: Johnny James is convinced that Albert Ford betrayed him. He asked me to get rid of Albert and bring his mane as proof. I should report to the Sheriff for now.

candidates.title: Shawn McCurdy's Weapon 1
candidates.description: Sheriff Warp said ^4d4dffForeman McCurdy^000000 has a good bargaining chip. He's in the plaza.

candidates.title: Shawn McCurdy's Weapon 2
candidates.description: I could get some purple ores, which I thought could no longer be mined because of the Buffalo Bandits. I should find Shawn McCurdy ^4d4dffsouth from the entrance to the mine^000000.

candidates.title: Shawn McCurdy's Weapon 3
candidates.description: We were able to sneak into the second floor of the mine. I should get ^4d4dff1 Purple Ore^000000, and then talk with Shawn.

candidates.title: Hear Me Out 2
candidates.description: I should ^4d4dffknock on the signaling rock 3 times^000000, and then talk with Albert Ford about his gang's future.

candidates.title: Happy for Broken Trust
candidates.description: Albert Ford, convinced Johnny James betrayed his gang, has agreed to make a deal. I should deliver Albert's Mane to Johnny James as proof.

candidates.title: Location of the Ores
candidates.description: Johnny told me where he hid the ores: ^4d4dffunder the elevator on the second floor of the mine^000000. I should report to Sheriff Warp with this information.

candidates.title: Location of the Ores 2
candidates.description: ^4d4dffShawn McCurdy^000000 is at the ^4d4dfftemporary entrance to the second floor of the mine^000000. I should tell him where the ores are and follow him to the inside of the mine.

candidates.title: Location of the Ores 3
candidates.description: The broken elevator is to the north from the center of the second floor. I should find an ^4d4dffOre Box^000000 underneath the elevator, and bring it to Shawn McCurdy.

candidates.title: Ace up Our Sleeve
candidates.description: I should get rid of some Buffalo Bandits and collect ^4d4dff5 Brown Mufflers and 5 Bandit Scarves^000000 to show Albert Ford. He'll hit the roof.

candidates.title: Case Solved
candidates.description: I might have burned my bridges with Albert Ford, but I don't care. I don't have to see him anymore. I should report to Sheriff Warp.

candidates.title: Collecting Ores
candidates.description: Collected the ores.

candidates.title: 두번째 작전
candidates.description: 아인브로크 북-서 필드의 폐광산에서 새로운 작전이 수행 될 예정이다. 대기 중인 리벨리온 대원과 만나 작전에 합류하자.

candidates.title: Quitting Job Change
candidates.description: Give up changing your job to Assassin and go back to town.

candidates.title: Job Change to Assassin
candidates.description: Fill out the form to apply for the job of Assassin and take the test.
candidates.goal: Applying for Job Change to Assassin

candidates.title: Job Change to Assassin
candidates.description: You must get at least 9 out of 10 questions to pass the test.
candidates.goal: Written Test for Job Change to Assassin

candidates.title: Job Change to Assassin
candidates.description: You must catch 6 "Job change target" to pass the test.

candidates.title: Job Change to Assassin
candidates.description: Your Hiding skill is to be tested. You must use your hiding skills with potion until you reach the other side of the room without defeating any monsters.

candidates.title: Job Change to Assassin
candidates.description: Go to the final testing hall.

candidates.title: Find the Guild Master!
candidates.description: You must go through the maze and find the Guild Master.

candidates.title: Acceptance from the Guild Master
candidates.description: Bring the Necklace from the Guild Master and go meet the Assassin Expert "Huey".
candidates.goal: Delivery of the necklace from the Guildmaster

candidates.title: Job Change to Assassin
candidates.description: You've now become an Assassin !!

candidates.title: Applying for Job Change to Priest
candidates.description: Accept the Three Trials of Priesthood to change the job.
candidates.goal: Applying for Job Change to Priest

candidates.title: Job Change to Priest
candidates.description: You must make a pilgrimage. First, visit Rubalkabara who is Northeast Prontera Ruins. Second, visit Sister Mathilda who is near Morocc, Southwest of Prontera. Finally, visit Father Yosuke in a field Northwest of Prontera.

candidates.title: Job Change to Priest
candidates.description: Move to the place where the Spiritual Training takes place. Talk with Peter S. Alberto.

candidates.title: Job Change to Priest
candidates.description: Start training. Defeat all the monsters! Show no mercy to the creatures of darkness!

candidates.title: Job Change to Priest
candidates.description: You've completed the Spiritual Training! Go see the Sister Cecilia.

candidates.title: Job Change to Priest
candidates.description: Make a promise to devote yourself to God.

candidates.title: Job Change to Priest
candidates.description: You have completed all 3 missions as you made the oath of Priesthood. Go back to the Bishop Paul.
candidates.goal: Applying for Job Change to Priest

candidates.title: Job Change to Priest
candidates.description: You've now become a Priest!!

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: Zelmeto has asked you to help him inspect the machines in the factory one at a time to know which one needs to be fixed. Find the 2nd control panel and report back to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: You found the 2nd control panel and it is completely broken. Report this back to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: Zelmeto asked you to inspect the automatic pressure governors and to report any problems no matter how small they may seem.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: You found the automatic pressure governors and after checking more carefully, you find that it's making strange grinding noises and a few of the surface screws are loose. Report your findings to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: Now Zelmeto asked you to inspect another control panel. It's similar to the first one but bigger. It's located in the middle of the factory. Find it and report back to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: The main control panel doesn't look like it has any problems. But after tapping on its surface, you hear a disheartening hollow sound. It looks like it's missing some parts... Report your findings to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: Zelmeto asked you to inspect a mechanical hand that transports small objects. Find it and report your findings to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: The conveyor's movements look jittery and clumsy. The mechanical arm also doesn't look powerful enough to bear the loads that it's carrying... Report your findings to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: Now you must inspect a pipe located near the large cauldrons of molten metal and report your findings to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: The pipe you found is bloated and worn out from long durations of being overloaded with pressure. It's a wonder it hasn't exploded yet. Report your findings to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: The final thing Zelmeto has asked you to inspect is a bigger and more powerful conveyor. Find it and report your findings to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: This last conveyor seems to have similar problems to its smaller version. Its movements are awkward, erratic and weak, and almost all of its screws are rusted. Report your findings to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: Zelmeto tells you that he needs to request an increase in the Factory Repair budget from the superintendant to make sure they have enough materials for the repairs. Find the superintendant.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: The superintendant refused to approve the increase in the Factory Repair budget. You'd better report the bad news to Zelmeto.

candidates.title: Factory Inspection
candidates.description: Zelmeto still wants to make the repairs so he has asked you to bring back ^FF000020 Flexible Tube^000000, ^FF000010 Rusty Screw^000000, and ^FF000010 Used Iron Plate^000000 so they can make the needed repairs.

candidates.title: Tarlock's Favor
candidates.description: Tarlock says that he wouldn't mind telling you how the Airship works if you do him a favor of delivering a letter to his brother Ferlock.
candidates.goal: Deliver Tarlock's letter to his brother

candidates.title: Ferlock's Favor
candidates.description: Ferlock has asked you retrieve his stolen things from the monsters that attack Tarlock's Airship. Bring 2 Will of the Darkness and 2 Prickly Fruit back to Ferlock.

candidates.title: Ferlock's Favor
candidates.description: Ferlock asked you to take his reply to his brother Tarlock for him.
candidates.goal: Deliver the letter from Ferlock to his brother, Tarlock

candidates.title: How the Airship Works
candidates.description: You have delivered Ferlock's letter to Tarlock. Now may be a good time to ask him about how the Airship Works.

candidates.title: Hallen's Favor
candidates.description: Hallen has asked you to deliver a letter to Kaci from someone named Mr. Mawong who is something like her mentor.

candidates.title: The Dice Roller
candidates.description: You have delivered Hallen's letter to Kaci. You should probably find out what she knows...

candidates.title: The Dice Roller
candidates.description: It turns out that Kaci is Hallen's cousin. After answering your questions she has gone back to running her games. Who else would know of their past?

candidates.title: Secret of Airships
candidates.description: Hallen tells you that his project is to learn more about how the Airships work. It could benefit you to ask someone who would be knowledgeable about Airships for yourself and report your findings to Hallen.

candidates.title: Secret of Airships
candidates.description: "Really...? Are you serious? An imitation of Ymir's Heart Piece. Now where have I heard about that before? Mm, let me think..."

candidates.title: Secret of Airships
candidates.description: Kaci told me about a drunkard that always mentions Ymir's Heart when he plays the Dice game for Apples!

candidates.title: Secret of Airships
candidates.description: You find out that the director at the Einbroch Laboratory has a piece of Ymir's Heart. It's worth investigating...

candidates.title: Secret of Airships
candidates.description: You better get out of here. The guards patrol this place regularly, so you're almost sure to get caught. Hmm, come and see me later at the Airship, alright? Now hurry!
candidates.goal: You must go and see Ferlock

candidates.title: Euslan's Fiancee
candidates.description: "...Are you really willing to go out and look for Thierry for me? Oh, thank you so much! You don't know how much your kind offer means to me. Thierry went on a trip, traveling on one of the Airships, to find some medicine that the doctors say I need for my illness."

candidates.title: Tips from Kaci
candidates.description: "Ah, I know! I'll ask the Airship Captain to help you: he's got the list of passengers and their destinations."
candidates.goal: Check out the passengers list from the captain

candidates.title: Ferlock's Passengers list
candidates.description: According to this, he last took an Airship to Hugel. That's all that this says.

candidates.title: Euslan's Favor
candidates.description: "If you get the chance, please visit my brother Eukran in Hugel, and ask him where my Thierry might be."

candidates.title: Eukran's Testimony
candidates.description: "You see, Thierry passed by here about a month ago, and told me that he had to visit the Odin Shrine. I wasn't sure then, but now I think he's trying to help my sister."

candidates.title: Thierry's Favor
candidates.description: "I can't really go into the details, but I'm doing this work to find a cure for Euslan's disease. It's not curable by modern medicine..."

candidates.title: Danger coming on to Thierry
candidates.description: "Thierry seems to have caught on to what we're really up to. I think that's why he's slowing down on his research. We better get rid of him before it's too late."

candidates.title: Euslan's Medicine
candidates.description: "It doesn't matter what happens to me, but I must save Euslan. I only need 5 Runes of the Darkness to finish that medicine. Please help me get them, adventurer..."

candidates.title: Thierry's Favor
candidates.description: "Please understand that I want to see her as soon as I can, but I have to wait until those Rekenber agents stop searching for me. Please give that medicine to Euslan as soon as you can: her life depends on it."

candidates.title: Find Postell
candidates.description: "Find Allen's son Postell and to tell him to bring his medicine! Head east, go outside of town, and you should be able to find Postell."

candidates.title: Message from Postell
candidates.description: Postell has asked you to do him a favor and make sure that his dad doesn't get himself into any more trouble.

candidates.title: Nursing Allen
candidates.description: "Wh-what if I have another ulcer attack before Postell can bring my meds?! I might not survive! A-adventurer, would you please stay by my side until my son arrives?"

candidates.title: Little something in return
candidates.description: "Please take a look inside the medicine drawer, and help yourself to whatever you like" ~Allen

candidates.title: Grumbling Manainne
candidates.description: Talk with Manainne about the comforting tree.

candidates.title: Talk with El Schatt
candidates.description: "This tree means so much to everyone in this town, and we all have special memories of this place. But that El Schatt fellow plans to chop it down for his shop..." -Manainne

candidates.title: Talk with Perfitz
candidates.description: El Schatt says that his father's been wanting to build a shop here for a long time. Talk with his father Perfitz and get his side of the story.

candidates.title: Stubborn El Schatt
candidates.description: "Although I'm pleased, I get this gut feeling that something's not right, like he's too excited about cutting that tree down. Maybe this old man is just too suspicious~" -Perfitz

candidates.title: Stories of the past
candidates.description: El Schatt says that there was a time when he would have protected the tree with his life but that it should be buried in the past. You should find someone that might know about his past.

candidates.title: Kanainne
candidates.description: "Now El Schatt is just a heartless, money grubbing...! He's completely changed. My sister would be rolling in her grave, seeing him now..." -Manainne

candidates.title: Kanainne's spirit
candidates.description: "I... I can borrow my sister's body? Yes, if she cooperates, maybe... Maybe it will work. I must... must do something before he... he... he hurts himself even more..."

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: Please take this order of Fish Cake Soup to my friend Neha. I'm grateful that she's a regular customer..

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: Take this next order of Fish Cake Soup to Maewan, another one of my regulars.

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: Please take it to my roommate Layoma. But... Be careful. She's got a thing about punctuality. Just try not to be late...

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: Quick, take this Fish Paste Soup to Erjan. Um, but be careful, he's really nitpicky...

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: You're late! Don't you know this soup isn't good if it isn't steaming hot? But... I'll forgive you... On one condition. Bring me ^FF00001 Whip^000000 with which to spank you. You better hurry, or I won't let you off so easily.

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: "Argh, but you're late! This is your fault, you know that, right? I can forgive you if you help me with my collection. Just bring me 1 Bookclip in Memory, alright?"
candidates.goal: Bring 1 Bookclip in Memory to Maewan

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: "I can't let you continue delivering for Cellette unless you prove that you're dependable to me. Erm, bring me ^ff00001 Mushroom Spore^000000, and I'll forget this whole thing."

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: "Hm, but as the first son of the Franchesfeschu family, I cannot eat this soup unless it is suitably prepared. Go! I command you to bring me the commoner's ^ff0000China^000000!"

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: "Ooh, did I accidentally whip you twice? Heh heh... Well, I'm satisfied. I'll go ahead and tell Cellette that you did a good job... I hope you come deliver my soup again~"

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: "Great, you really brought me a Bookclip in Memory! Yes, this'll make a fine addition to my collection~ Oh, and give me my soup. Thanks again for delivering~"

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: "Alright, maybe I can count on you to work for my roommate Cellette a little while longer. Oh, and please tell her not to come home so late all the time, okay?"

candidates.title: Cellette's Fish Cake Soup
candidates.description: "You are dismissed. Please take your leave, and return to Cellette with my noble thanks."

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: I know I'm acting like a complete idiot. But I'd give anything to see Calla... Just don't listen to anything I say. I'm just a poor fool in love with the wrong person. That has to be it....

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: Well, maybe I can't see him, but would you give my violin to Klitzer for me? I used to play this for him all the time...

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: That's my daughter's Violin. I gave that to her for her sweet sixteen... You've crossed the line, punk! Guards! Get over here!

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: All you need to do is just give her ^FF00001 Flower^000000. I don't have the zeny and I don't think I'm welcome at Kapellthaine Manor.

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: Oh, if you pass by Einbroch, would you thank Klitzer for the flower for me please? A-and... And... Please tell him that I really miss him a lot.

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: I feel so much better now. Oh! When you have the time, why don't you talk with my mother? She always likes meeting my friends.

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: I can't bear to see the petty hatred between our two towns stop my son from seeing the woman he loves... Find someone who may know of the history of Einbroch and Einbech.

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: Why don't you bring me ^990000Coals^000000? It's not impossible for someone like yourself, but this kind of task will require some effort on your part.

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: Well, I shall try to find some use for these. I'm afraid the gift I've asked from you isn't very practical. How is Coal usually used? Ah, I have a novel idea! It seems that bringing Coals will get Satra to talk.

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: Anyway, when you next meet Klitzer, please tell him to pay me a visit soon. Oh, and remind him to dress appropriately for this special occasion. Ho ho ho ho ho~!

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: Eh...? What did you just say? Did you just say that Calla's mother wants me to have tea with her? Holy moley...!!

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: Thank you for helping my son Klitzer. Sadly, the little fool doesn't have any clue when it comes to certain things like choosing clothing. A man should wear nice clothes, like a Formal Suit or a Tuxedo, for important meetings and special occasions.

candidates.title: Klitzer and Calla
candidates.description: You've really opened my eyes. From now on, I'll do my best to earn the approval of Calla's parents and become worthy of Calla's love.

candidates.title: Stolen Gemstone
candidates.description: I don't have any proof, but I suspect it was stolen by Phobe, a servant that disappeared about the same time the gem disappeared. You might want to question the other servants of his whereabouts.
candidates.goal: Get some information on Phobe's whereabouts

candidates.title: Mr. Manson
candidates.description: Truth be told, I don't know much since I just started working here. Why don't you ask the senior employees? You could ask Mr. Manson inside the mansion.

candidates.title: Jenny the gardener
candidates.description: Ah, our gardener Jenny was the one that introduced me to him. She's worked for Sir Zhed for a long time, and she loves kids. You know, if you want to know more about that kid, you should talk with Jenny.

candidates.title: Searching the Market
candidates.description: Alright, I guess I can go to the market and ask around.

candidates.title: Mysterious Message
candidates.description: So yeah, last night, some guy asked me to tell anyone looking for this guy named Phobe to give you a message. Basically, he wants you to come to the "ice cave". Let's see, his name was... Nogan? Rogan? Something like that.

candidates.title: Double Crossed?
candidates.description: Vincent's instructions were to defeat anyone that asked about Rogan, some name he made up. It looks like he set us up, dude. Sorry, if I had known, I wouldn't have done it.

candidates.title: Find Phobe
candidates.description: You won't get in trouble if I can find the jewel and Phobe before Sir Zhed returns, so I'll try to find them for you as soon as I can. Phobe is just a kid, so he's probably hiding somewhere in town...

candidates.title: Stolen Gemstone Found
candidates.description: Just so you know, I don't plan on going back home! Well, just not this second anyway. But let my mom know that I'm fine and not to worry.

candidates.title: Informing Jenny
candidates.description: While I return this jewel, would you please tell my wife Jenny that our boy is okay? She's been very worried about him, so...

candidates.title: Keeping the Secret
candidates.description: Thank you for all of your help, adventurer~

candidates.title: Vincent's Recommendation
candidates.description: This note is a letter of recommendation hat I have written for you. Please deliver it to Sir Zhed as soon as possible. Good bye, and thank you for everything.

candidates.title: Recommendation from High Priest Zhed
candidates.description: While I finish writing this recommendation, let me tell you how to get to the pope's office where you must go once you gather 40 Glacial Hearts.
candidates.goal: Gather 40 Glacial Hearts and go see the Pope

candidates.title: Recommendation from High Priest Zhed
candidates.description: I really want to thank you for coming to speak to me. I had a great time learning. Now I have to go officiate services, so... This is goodbye for now...

candidates.title: Recommendation from High Priest Zhed
candidates.description: I'm sorry, but we're not quite finished with our discussion. Why don't you wait and relax in the next room over there in the meantime?

candidates.title: Recommendation from High Priest Zhed
candidates.description: I want to give you a bit of advice. Don't get too close to High Priest Zhed. If you do, you might end up getting yourself in trouble...

candidates.title: Recommendation from High Priest Zhed
candidates.description: Ah, but before you go, let me warn you not to ^FF0000go near the Holy Ground^000000. I repeat, stay away from the Holy Ground.

candidates.title: Recommendation from High Priest Zhed
candidates.description: I warned Bekento that he might cause trouble for you, but it seems that you've caused trouble for him. Understand this: most intruders are severely punished, but because of my friendship with Bekento, I'm letting you off easy. Remember that...

candidates.title: Mr. Shendar's daughter
candidates.description: Mr. Shendar says that his daughter has been going out with someone. She went to some town for that boy and he hasn't heard from her since. Find someone who may know what may have happened to her.

candidates.title: Lachellen's Testimony
candidates.description: Ooh, I'm so jealous of Bruspetti! She's been spending so much time with her new boyfriend recently... But she still refuses to tell me what his name is. Let's see... He grew up in Lighthalzen? That's all she knows.

candidates.title: A Foreigner, Katinshuell
candidates.description: Katinshuell told you that he and his girlfriend's relationship is over. Maybe he is talking about Mr. Shendar's daughter. You should ask him about it.

candidates.title: Bruspetti's scent
candidates.description: Mr. Shendar says that his daughter Bruspetti has a distinct pleasant scent like her mother. You should search for someone with distinct pleasant scent in Lighthalzen.
candidates.goal: Search for Bruspetti's scent in Lighthalzen

candidates.title: Bruspetti's scent
candidates.description: This... This smell... It smells so nice! Like rose petals riding on a gentle breeze... Wait, could this be the scent that Bruspetti's father mentioned earlier?
candidates.goal: Go back to Rachel and meet Lachellen

candidates.title: Lachellen's Testimony
candidates.description: If she's in Lighthalzen, she's probably gone there to learn more about her boyfriend. Hmm, maybe if you check the place where she and her boyfriend usually went on dates, you might be able to find something.

candidates.title: Freya's Spring
candidates.description: I'm sorry if I startled you, but the ground that you're standing on is very slippery, you know.

candidates.title: Bruspetti's Diary
candidates.description: As a loving father, I can't allow myself to invade my precious daughter's privacy. Even if she did carelessly leave her diary on top of her drawer.
candidates.goal: Search for the diary on top of the drawer

candidates.title: Bruspetti's Diary
candidates.description: This must be Bruspetti's diary! But... reading it would make you feel like a real creep. You should ask Katinshuell if he knows why Bruspetti is in Lighthalzen.

candidates.title: Suspicious Katinshuell
candidates.description: Katinshuell insists on being left alone. Maybe someone else will know something else about Bruspetti's interest in Freya's Spring and Lighthalzen.

candidates.title: Lachellen's Testimony
candidates.description: Freya's Spring? Oh, I like that place! Speaking of which, I know someone named Katinshuell that went there pretty often. Usually men don't go alone...

candidates.title: Freya's Spring
candidates.description: See the edge of the spring? The same young man frequently comes to that spot, and stares into the water, just dripping with sadness. Someone so young shouldn't be feeling like that.

candidates.title: Talk with Mr. Shendar
candidates.description: Wait, wait... So someone has been sneaking around here? That's weird. Wait, that guy, the one that might be Bruspetti's boyfriend..

candidates.title: Bruspetti's Diary
candidates.description: You now have permission to take the diary with you so that you can figure out if Bruspetti and Katinshuell are connected... Bring the diary to Katinshuell.

candidates.title: Talk with Katinshuell
candidates.description: Tell me the truth! Actually, you know what? Why don't we look at the truth together? How's that?

candidates.title: Talk with Katinshuell
candidates.description: He's still resisting me... How can I get him to reveal the truth? Maybe there's something I could use to make him confess...

candidates.title: Bruspetti's resting place
candidates.description: ... Please just leave me alone. I've lost the woman I love because of something stupid I did in the past. If you want to turn me in, go ahead...

candidates.title: Ayotaya's world famous dish, Tom Yum Goong
candidates.description: Anyone can make Tom Yum Goong, but I recommend that you go visit ^3131FFMali the Spicy^000000. She's the best cook. Why don't you ask her to cook for you?

candidates.title: Ayotaya's world famous dish, Tom Yum Goong
candidates.description: You can buy the freshest Shrimp from the guy named, "^3131FFThongpool^000000". Get 20 Shrimps to cook Tom Yum Goong.
candidates.goal: Bring 20 shrimps to Mali the Spicy

candidates.title: Ayotaya's world famous dish, Tom Yum Goong
candidates.description: Mali the Spicy has found a very nice lemon tree around, however, those lemons were not for sale. You must get some lemon from the owner of the lemon tree.
candidates.goal: Bring 10 lemons to Mali the Spicy

candidates.title: Ayotaya's world famous dish, Tom Yum Goong
candidates.description: Now you must get "^CE0000Chilli^000000" and other materials from the market. Ask the merchant at the market and you'll know what materials to get.
candidates.goal: Bring 30 Chilli and other materials to Mali the Spicy

candidates.title: Momotaro Field Trip
candidates.description: The Chief said Dokebi earned 20 million zeny by hacking others' accounts... Since we towners spend our time sitting and chatting, we can't defeat Dokebis because we're low level, so...Please do it for us.

candidates.title: Momotaro Field Trip
candidates.description: Now, the Momotaro story is over. You can get your reward when you talk with the Publisher lady you saw first.

candidates.title: Momotaro Field Trip
candidates.description: ..At this point I'm supposed to send you back...BUT! I will give you a chance. But if you fail, ^3163FFyou can't take this challenge.^000000 Also, this mission will be pretty hard.

candidates.title: Momotaro Field Trip
candidates.description: You are really something. You've got the moves, kiddo. Let me show you the exit. I had a great time...Don't forget to get your reward.

candidates.title: The mother of lord in Amatsu
candidates.description: The mother of our lord is resting in here. She has been sick for months. That is why she is staying in here.

candidates.title: The mother of lord in Amatsu
candidates.description: You, who hail from Rune-Midgard, may be able to cure my mother's disease. I will reward you well if you succeed.. My mother is living in a house outside of the palace. Come to me when you finish your treatment.
candidates.goal: Find the treatment to cure the mother of lord

candidates.title: Song of the fox
candidates.description: Priest, priest~ A fox is following me! If he doesn't leave when I scream and shout! The North Shrine Priest should help me out~ Ralralrah Ralralrah Ralralrahralralrah~~

candidates.title: Boy at the Northern Shrine
candidates.description: A stronger spirit will expel the fox from a human. Come on, yell out and show me your spirit!

candidates.title: Fox Expelled
candidates.description: ^FF6060Yelp! Yelp! Yelp! Human! To expel me from this body like this! Curse you! Darn you!! I will curse the Ishida family, and You better watch out, human!^000000

candidates.title: The Gray Wolf's Warning
candidates.description: You have met a Gray Wolf that warns you about someone named Koshei, the Immortal and tells you that you should leave this place. But who is this Koshei exactly? Maybe the Gray Wolf will come back and explain himself more...

candidates.title: Finding the Keymaker
candidates.description: Koshei seems to be an immortal evil being that was sealed away by a girl named Maria. Maria needs to be freed from her stone prison by finding the keymaker to make the ^0000ffGolden Key^000000.

candidates.title: Blacksmith's Request
candidates.description: The Blacksmith has asked you to bring him 25 Steel. He promised that he will explain how to make the "Golden Key" after you bring him the Steel.

candidates.title: The Golden Key
candidates.description: The Blacksmith says that you need ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, and 10 Golden Thread^000000 to make the Golden Key. Talk with the Blacksmith and he will tell you how to get the materials. And don't forget to wear those Strong Steel Boots.

candidates.title: The Red Ring
candidates.description: Vassili Grandpapa says that he had a Red Ring but that he gave it to his daughter Mashenka who unforunately passed away. But he has another daughter, named Ryubaba who might know about the Red Ring.

candidates.title: Mashenka's Red Ring
candidates.description: Ryubaba told you that her sister Mashenka was probably wearing the Red Ring when she disappeared around the marsh.

candidates.title: Searching the Marsh
candidates.description: You spoke with a Shepherdess near the marsh who asked you to bring her ^0000ff25 Pointed Branches^000000 while you search for Mashenka and her Red Ring.

candidates.title: The Flute's Voice
candidates.description: The Shepherdess made you a Wooden Flute out of the Branches you brought her. A strange voice sings a sad song when it is played. You should ask Ryubaba about the voice that sings in the flute.

candidates.title: Ryubaba's Confession
candidates.description: You can't live with yourself if you do not tell Vasilli the truth about what happened between his two daughters. Tell him what Ryubaba confessed to him about Mashenka and bring the Wooden Flute as evidence.

candidates.title: Worried Mother's Request
candidates.description: You have met a worried Mother who told you a story about the water nymph Lusalka who may or may not be her daughter. Continue your conversation with the worried Mother.

candidates.title: Finding Lusalka
candidates.description: In order to find the aqua nymph Lusalka, you must find an area of water between the hours of 5pm and 6am PST and bring Holy Water to protect yourself from her dangerous stare.

candidates.title: Lusalka's Beloved
candidates.description: Lusalka has asked you to find her beloved Igor at the capital of the Rune Midgarts Kingdom and give him her golden earrings and deliver her message of telling him to stop suffering.

candidates.title: Lusalka's Beloved
candidates.description: You found a wanderer from Moscovia who travelled to Prontera with Igor but they have since parted ways. He said that Igor was headed for a desert... The nearest desert you know of is...

candidates.title: Searching for Igor
candidates.description: A villager in Morocc says that he may have seen Igor and that he went into the Pyramid. Maybe you have finally tracked him down so you can deliver Lusalka's golden earrings to him.

candidates.title: Igor's message
candidates.description: Igor asked you to go to Lusalka and tell her that he still loves her. Maybe now she will agree to give you her hair so you can make the Golden Key. Remember to bring a "Holy Water" when you talk with Lusalka to protect yourself from her stare.

candidates.title: Marozka's Cave
candidates.description: Marozka says that he needs to test your worthiness to fight against Koshei. Bring him 100 Well Baked Cookies from the Stone Furnace and 100 Apples from the Apple Tree in his cave.

candidates.title: The Golden Thread
candidates.description: You have brought the cookies and apples to Marozka. He says that making the Golden Thread will take him a while to make it. Come back in one hour and he will surely have it ready.

candidates.title: Test of mind and wisdom
candidates.description: You must pass all of Marozka's tests and he will give you the Golden Thread that he just made.

candidates.title: The Keymaker
candidates.description: The keymaker is at a cabin deep inside of the forest. Beware of the keymaker's words and don't forget the blacksmith's protection spell, "^0000ffSpellshield Protection^000000".

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: Baba Yaga has asked you to do her a favor of finding her cow that ran away and that you must find her and cast a return spell on it. The spell is "^ff0000Good feed is orange-flavored^000000".

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: You have cast the return spell on Baba Yaga's cow. Return to her and let her know that you have done the favor she asked you to do.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: Baba Yaga has asked you to do her a favor and find a way to quiet down a noisy coffin behind her house in exchange for her making the Golden Key for you.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: You have managed to quiet down the noisy coffin behind Baba Yaga's house. Return to her and let her know that you have done the favor she asked you to do.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: Baba Yaga has asked you to do her a favor and bring back her precious Silver Spoon which pirates in a sunken ship stole from her in exchange for her making the Golden Key for you.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: You have found Baba Yaga's Silver Spoon that the pirates stole from her. Return to her and let her know that you have done the favor she asked you to do.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: Baba Yaga has asked you to do her a favor by buying her a magic book from Momotaro in Amatsu. It is reserved under her name so all you have to do is go there and buy it for her.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: You have bought the magic books and given them to Baba Yaga. Talk with her again to see if she has completed making the Golden Key.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: Baba Yaga has asked you to do her a favor and find a way to quiet the House ghost living in a jar next to her cabin in exchange for her making the Golden Key for you.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: After playing a card game with the house ghost, it promises that it will be quiet now. Return to Baba Yaga and let her know that you have done the favor she asked you to do.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: Baba Yaga has asked you to do her a favor and go to Broom Grandmother in Payon and buy her a broom in exchange for her making the Golden Key for you.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Favor
candidates.description: After playing dice with the ghost tree you have finally received the Broom that Baba Yaga asked you to get. Return to Baba Yaga and let her know that you have done the favor she asked you to do.

candidates.title: The Golden Key
candidates.description: You have finally received the Golden Key from Baba Yaga. Now it is time to free Maria Morebna from her imprisonment inside that wall.

candidates.title: Koshei, the Immortal
candidates.description: Gray Wolf will take care of Maria's wounds. You must do what you can to subdue Koshei.

candidates.title: Living and Dead Water
candidates.description: Gray Wolf says that you can save Maria if you get "Life Water" and "Death Water" from Baba Yaga.

candidates.title: Living and Dead Water
candidates.description: In order to make the "Living Water" you need to bring 1 Holy Water and 2 Yggdrasil Leaves and for the "Dead Water" you need to bring 1 Cursed Water and 10 Hinalle Leaflets.

candidates.title: Living and Dead Water
candidates.description: Baba Yaga has given you the "Living Water" and "Dead Water". Go to Maria quickly. You must first pour the "Dead Water" to remove the wound and curses and then pour the "Living Water" to bring her spirit back.

candidates.title: Sight Blaster
candidates.description: This skill sounds easy but it's pretty hard to learn. Knights are experts with skills that push enemies back, so go and find one who'll explain Push Back theory to you in Prontera. Check the 11 o' clock direction on your Mini-Map.

candidates.title: Push Back Theory
candidates.description: Well, I've explained pushing as best as I can. Concentrate and practice the theory on your own, and you hould be able to do it.

candidates.title: Sight Blaster
candidates.description: I'm no philanthropist, so I expect some tuition for all of my instruction and effort! Go and bring me ^ff000010 Crystal Blues, 10 Green Lives, 10 Red Bloods, 10 Winds of Verdure^000000!

candidates.title: Elemental Converter
candidates.description: Please bring the required materials so that we can construct a basic elemental converter. You need ^ff00007 Horns, 12 Rainbow Shells, 10 Snail's Shells, 4 Blank Scrolls, 10 Scorpion Tails^000000.
candidates.goal: Return to Mishuna with the materials

candidates.title: Elemental Change
candidates.description: Now you're ready to learn the other skill, ^ff0000Elemental Change^000000....I need to prepare a few things for this lesson, so we'll meet and discuss this later, okay?

candidates.title: Fire Elemental Change
candidates.description: Please bring ^ff000020 Red Bloods, 1 Payon Solution, 1 Morocc Solution^000000, then you'll be able to learn ^ff0000Fire Elemental Change^000000.
candidates.goal: Return to Mishuna with the materials

candidates.title: Earth Elemental Change
candidates.description: Please bring ^ff000020 Green Lives, 1 Payon Solution, 1 Morocc Solution^000000, then you'll be able to learn ^ff0000Earth Elemental Change^000000.
candidates.goal: Return to Mishuna with the materials

candidates.title: Wind Elemental Change
candidates.description: Please bring ^ff000020 Winds of Verdure, 1 Payon Solution, 1 Morocc Solution^000000, then you'll be able to learn ^ff0000Wind Elemental Change^000000.
candidates.goal: Return to Mishuna with the materials

candidates.title: Water Elemental Change
candidates.description: Please bring ^ff000020 Crystal Blues, 1 Payon Solution, 1 Morocc Solution^000000, then you'll be able to learn ^ff0000Water Elemental Change^000000.
candidates.goal: Return to Mishuna with the materials

candidates.title: Charming Wink
candidates.description: You must bring me ^FF00001 Crystal Mirror^0000000! This tool is imperative to the lesson, so fetch it and bring it to me quickly!

candidates.title: Charming Advisor
candidates.description: Now that you've established the proper attitude on beauty, it's time for you to learn an advanced technique of enticement. Go and find my sister in Prontera Chruch. She'll be willing to teach you.

candidates.title: Selfish Advisor
candidates.description: I want to have a real drink, ^FF0000Alcohol^000000ic. Oh, and I need some snacks to sustain all of my teaching energy! ^FF00001 Apple, 3 Bananas, 5 Well-Baked Cookies^000000 put on a fine ^FF0000China^000000.
candidates.goal: Return to Aelle with Alcoholic drink and the side dish

candidates.title: Selfish Advisor
candidates.description: Now, the easiest, most subtle and most appealing gesture of all time is the ^FF0000wink^000000. It's saved me in times of crisis, and mastering it will enhance your charms.

candidates.title: Drunken Advisor
candidates.description: G-go away. Talk with Canell, my sister...!..ZzzzzZzZZZzzzZZ..

candidates.title: Kind Canell
candidates.description: Now, a true Dancer should be able to figure out the secret to winking on her own. But since I'm such a kind woman, I will deign to explain it to you. Ho-ho~

candidates.title: The Tripartite Union's Feud
candidates.description: Those researchers complain a lot these days. They're terribly stressed out and I think somebody should really listen to their problems. Especially those dealing with document files argue with each other many times. You might wanna start by talking to them.

candidates.title: Document Delivery
candidates.description: Ok, now, please deliver the file to Hue and Hansenne. Hue's in charge of Schwartzvalt documents and Hansenne's in charge of Arunafeltz'. You should go see Hue at Schwartzvalt's office, otherwise, he'd be whining about it.
candidates.goal: Deliver the documents to Hue and Hansenne and return to Ryosen

candidates.title: Report to the United Research Official
candidates.description: Well, it's already spilled water. I need to go to that meeting whether I like it or not. Could you please send this to the Official of the United Research? In the mean time, I should prepare myself for the meeting.
candidates.goal: Deliver the documents to the United Research Official

candidates.title: United Research Official's Favor
candidates.description: Please, you should participate in the meeting and mediate them if anything goes wrong!First, you should go meet those 3 people and check them on preparing for the meeting. Hope they're not preparing any weapons, though.

candidates.title: Ryosen's Document Requests
candidates.description: I've requested something to Arunafeltz office but haven't got anything yet. Could you get it from Hansenne? I need that for the meeting but he never sends it to me. He must've forgotten about it, again!

candidates.title: Missing Document
candidates.description: I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge! But then,those pussy cats on the South-West can teach us fishing, you know. Maybe we can catch that document fishing on the river!
candidates.goal: Go back to Hansenne with the document you caught

candidates.title: Document Restoration
candidates.description: Schwartzwalt people have some talent in restoring things like this... Why don't you ask Hue to restore this? He'd scream so hard and the windows might break.

candidates.title: Document Restoration
candidates.description: It's completely soaked.. I should dry this thing first and iron these crumples. Then, I should restore the texts. I need some materials. You gotta help me on this. I need ^0000ff1 Folding Fan of Cat Ghost, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Squid Ink^000000.
candidates.goal: Bring 1 Folding Fan of Cat Ghost, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Squid Ink

candidates.title: Ryosen
candidates.description: The binding was too loose, so I re-arranged and binded the file all over. Please, deliver this file before it's too late.

candidates.title: Report to the United Research Official
candidates.description: Could you please ask the official to wait for me a bit? I have to find another document for the meeting.

candidates.title: Researchers' Meeting
candidates.description: Participate in the meeting

candidates.title: Hansenne is not guilty
candidates.description: All I wanted was to let those people be close to each other, become more friendly.. But, problems come up every single time. Can you think of any idea how to get those people along together?

candidates.title: Hansenne's Favor
candidates.description: He'll be ok soon. He'll get to think that it wasn't actually a big deal. But the thing is that... the relationship between Ryosen and Hue isn't looking good at all. Why don't you help them get along with each other?

candidates.title: Hue's Report
candidates.description: Here, this is the Rune-Midgard's report I took with me when everything went messy in the meeting room.. Could you please give this to Ryosen?

candidates.title: Report to the United Research Official
candidates.description: Ok. I should set up another meeting asap. Could you go see the official instead of me and set up a meeting?

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: Have you been learning the art of using Bash? I fervently believe that the Bash skill is the essense of Swordmanship!
candidates.goal: Master the skill, Bash, and return to Shurank

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: I see that you understand a little bit about the Bash skill. But still, it's not enough.
candidates.goal: Master the skill, Bash, and return to Shurank

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: I see that you've gained some proficiency with the Bash skill. But still, it's not enough.
candidates.goal: Master the skill, Bash, and return to Shurank

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: Those calluses...! Only a master of the Bash skill has those kinds of hands. Great work, Swordman. I'm very impressed.

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: By now, I believe that you know enough about the Increase HP Recovery skill. Next time, I shall teach you what I know about the Provoke skill.

candidates.title: Shurank's Order
candidates.description: I wish for you to find a Knight named ^5D478BDequ'ee^000000 in ^5D478BGeffen^000000. Listen carefully, this is the message: ^0000FFWhat happened to the murderer? ^0000FFDid you find out who he is? If you did, what are we supposed to do now?^000000
candidates.goal: Deliver Shurank's message to Dequ'ee in Geffen

candidates.title: Dequ'ee's Message
candidates.description: So Shurank is asking, "What happened to the murderer? Did you find out who he is? If you did, what are we supposed to do now?" We haven't found out who the murderer is for sure. However, we have a list of suspects and we'll figure it out soon.?
candidates.goal: Deliver Dequ'ee's message to Shurank in Izlude

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: You haven't learned Provoke yet? Now I ask that you train yourself in the use of Provoke.
candidates.goal: Master the skill, Provoke, and return to Shurank

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: Hm. You seem to have a basic understanding of Provoke, but let me give you a few details so that you can better understand the use of that skill.
candidates.goal: Master the skill, Provoke, and return to Shurank

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: Ah, I see that you have a fairly good understanding of the Provoke skill. Next time we speak, I will tell you what I know about the ^5D478BEndure^000000 skill. When you're ready to learn, come back to me.

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: Activating Endure enables you to shrug off attacks. You'll receive damage, but enemy attacks will not impede you as much. This means you can counter enemy attacks or escape if you need to. Alright. Now I want you to train in the use of the Endure skill. You can become a great Swordman.
candidates.goal: Master the skill, Endure, and return to Shurank

candidates.title: Shurank's order
candidates.description: Ah, once again, I have another task for you to perform. Please visit Dequ'ee in Geffen since it seems he has something to ask of you. Hurry and meet with Dequ'ee and return to me when you complete whatever it is that he wishes for you to do.

candidates.title: Dequ'ee's order
candidates.description: Now, I want you to go to Morocc and interrogate four suspects. Their names are ^5D478BMuetro^000000, ^5D478BGeil^000000, ^5D478BHans^000000 and ^5D478BBankley^000000. It shouldn't be too difficult. After you speak to all of them, come back and report to me.
candidates.goal: Return to Dequ'ee after finding the evidence in Morocc

candidates.title: The clue
candidates.description: TheisWesomeof...,Alright, great. Now all we have to do is figure out what all of this means. This is going to be really difficult. We have to figure this out, it's the only clue that we have....

candidates.title: Dequ'ee's Reasoning
candidates.description: Alright! It looks like Bankley is the murderer! Although we can't trust this 100%, this evidence is pretty conclusive. Hurry over to Morocc and monitor Bankley in case he does anything desperate. If something happens, report to me right away!

candidates.title: Bankley's Death
candidates.description: -He's dead! Bankley had a sad, pitiable expression on his face. Since the color is still fresh in his cheeks, he died only a little while ago. here is a long, deep wound in his chest, and a blood drenched knife is clenched in his right hand.-

candidates.title: Return to Shurank
candidates.description: Suicide...? Something shady's going on here! As for the other three suspects, I'll make sure that they're monitored by members of the Swordman Association. It looks like this case is closed for now. Once again, thanks for your help. Why don't you report back to Shurank now? I guess he still wants to show you the ropes of Swordmanship.

candidates.title: Shurank's Lecture
candidates.description: This will be my final lecture to you. Please listen carefully as I tell you all about Magnum Break.

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: You can't really be a Merchant if you can't even carry around goods to sell. Increase Weight Limit skill up to Level 4. After that, we can talk more about becoming a true Merchant.
candidates.goal: Return to Guarnien after mastering the skill, Increase Weight Limit

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: I'll talk about the Mammonite skill, just a basic skill as Item Appraisal. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture.

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: Now, I was going to tell you about ^FF0000Discount^000000 skill, right?

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: Alright! Now, in order to become closer towards becoming a true Merchant, I want you to learn the Discount skill up to Level 4.
candidates.goal: Return to Guarnien after mastering the skill, Discount

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: Alright, my next lesson will hopefully offer you a bit more of a challenge. Come back when you think you're ready, alright?

candidates.title: Prontera Market Research
candidates.description: You'll find some NPCs selling 10 Red Potions in Prontera. Your task is to buy the potions for the cheapest price.
candidates.goal: Buy 10 bottles of the cheapeast Red Potion in Prontera and return to Guarnien

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: Let me tell you about ^871F78Over Charge^000000.

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: Like Discount, Over Charge is a Passive skill that can be mastered at Skill Level 10. Personally, I think you should learn this skill for sure! For your next assignment, learn Over Charge up to Level 4. It shouldn't be too difficult to do.
candidates.goal: Return to Guarnien after mastering the skill, Over Charge

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: Push Cart skill. Be ready for this lecture, as Push Cart is one of the more important skills for a Merchant.

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: First off, you need to know Level 5 Increase Weight Limit before you can even learn the Push Cart skill. As you can see, this skill is an advanced form of the Increase Weight Limit skill. You can procure a PushCart from most Kafra Ladies for a certain fee. For now, why don't you learn the Push Cart skill up to Level 4?
candidates.goal: Return to Guarnien after mastering the Cart Skill

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: I believe it's time for my final lecture. I'll discuss the definitive skill of the Merchant: ^871F78Vending^000000.

candidates.title: Guarnien's Lecture
candidates.description: For your final assignment, I will ask you to learn the Vending skill up to Skill Level 4. Of course, once you do, I'll give you a little reward. I'll be waiting, so do your best~
candidates.goal: Return to Guarnien after mastering the Vending Skill

candidates.title: Research progress

candidates.title: Compressing Information
candidates.description: Go back to the Rune-Midgart Magician and see if he knows how to compress information using his magic.

candidates.goal: Find an Unidentified Mineral and bring it back to Magician Whisper

candidates.title: Injection of Magic
candidates.description: Please wait for a while as Magician Whisper works with the jewel.

candidates.title: Handworked jewels

candidates.title: Language translation device
candidates.description: I need to make the device which can read the magic code from the jewels. It should only take me 1 hour to finish making it.

candidates.description: The third test is how you can use a wolf effectively. Control the wolf and dismantle all of the bombs that are summoned!
