candidates.description: Deliver Digotz's message to Maku "-Hopeless Bastard! -You're still a stubborn jerk! -You owe me at least 3 lunches! -Not to mention an apology! -But who cares what you think?! -I'm so goddamn happy without you!"

candidates.title: Maku's other friend
candidates.description: After calming down, Maku says that his friend Benkaistein would always make sure that he stays out of fights. Maybe Digotz knows of this Benkaistein as well...

candidates.title: Benkaistein
candidates.description: Digotz tells you that Benkaistein has an answer for the kind of situation that he and Maku are in. He's studying in a place with a lot of books...

candidates.title: Benkaistein's lost item
candidates.description: Help Benkaistein find what he has lost and bring it back to him.

candidates.title: Kazien
candidates.description: An Old Man in Lighthalzen asked you to find a man named Kazien inside the corporation building to see if you can help him out.

candidates.title: Researcher Garins
candidates.description: Visit Garins in the Einbroch Laboratory and confirm that he received his order. Kazien has asked you to keep it secret from anyone so be discrete and careful of who you ask for.

candidates.title: Failed mission
candidates.description: You have failed your mission for Kazien because you revealed too much information. Kazien may give you another chance if you try...

candidates.title: No entrance
candidates.description: You're having difficulty getting past the Laboratory Guard. You should let Kazien know of your difficulties, otherwise you may never finish this job

candidates.title: Lyozien
candidates.description: Find a man named Lyozien in the Airship for international flights. As before, keep it discrete and don't tell anyone else about the job.

candidates.title: Meet Mr. Ahman
candidates.description: Complete the mission by meeting Mr. Ahman at Izlude Airport and come back to Lyozien.

candidates.title: Delivery complete
candidates.description: After speaking to Mr. Ahman, you should inform Lyozien that your delivery is complete.

candidates.title: More missions
candidates.description: Lyozien says that his brother Kazien may have another job for you.

candidates.title: Ghalstein
candidates.description: You have overheard Ghalstein in a suspicious conversation. Try to get more information about what you may have heard.

candidates.title: Sneaking into the Laboratory
candidates.description: You need to sneak into the hidden laboratory by investigating the disappearances of people from the eastside slums and bring back proof to Ghalstein.

candidates.title: Membership approved
candidates.description: Find Gusharr near Juno and he will tell you about your next mission. Show him the Membership Card to prove that you are working with Ghalstein.

candidates.title: Meeting the President
candidates.description: Show your Membership card to the President's secretary. You can only visit President Weierstrass from 8:00pm to 11:00pm and 11:00am to 2:00pm PST.

candidates.title: The President's Mission
candidates.description: Bring the file folder to the President's secretary Ms. Hes O'Neil before you leave then meet with Benith at the kafra Headquarters in Al De Baran to find out your next mission.

candidates.title: Rescuing a Secret Wing Member
candidates.description: You must find agent Jargeah near a broken bridge somewhere between Einbroch and Lighthalzen. He is wounded and in need of assistance so get there before the enemy does.

candidates.title: The Sealed File Folder
candidates.description: Jargeah gave you a Sealed Folder. You should report back to Benith at Kafra Headquarters.

candidates.title: The Sealed File Folder
candidates.description: Deliver the Sealed File Folder to President Weierstrass in Lighthalzen.

candidates.title: Shinokas the researcher
candidates.description: Your next mission is to find Shinokas the researcher who has a secret about the Rekenber Corporation. He has been reportedly seen somewhere in Einbroch.

candidates.title: Kafra Corporation Agent
candidates.description: Find the Kafra Corporation Agent in lighthalzen field.

candidates.title: Rekenber's Secret Archive
candidates.description: Use the pass for the Rekenber buildings and meet up with agent Lestin who will explain your mission.

candidates.title: Rekenber's Secret Archive
candidates.description: Sneak into the Secret Archive with Lestin's pass (something is written on the back of the pass) when the guards change shifts. Bring back any evidence that you can find.

candidates.title: Rekenber's Secret Archive
candidates.description: Find Esuna outside of Lighthalzen and relay the information that you found in the Secret Archive.

candidates.title: Kurelle the traitor
candidates.description: Return to the President with news of the Secret Wing traitor Kurelle. Then return to Ghalstein for the antidote for the red poison that he gave you.

candidates.title: Lost Engagement Ring
candidates.description: Help Shuda find her lost engagement ring, which her fiance Annon threw into the water. You should probably find something to fish it out.

candidates.title: Engagement Ring Found
candidates.description: You found Shuda's engagement ring inside of a Phen that you fished dout of the water. Bring it back to her.

candidates.title: Find Annon
candidates.description: Now that Shuda has her engagement ring back you should find Annon and let him know. There has to be someone who must have seen him.

candidates.title: Searching for Annon
candidates.description: You ran into an old-man who said that a young man ran past him into the forest. Could it have been Annon? Search for any traces of his whereabouts in the forest.

candidates.title: Traces of blood
candidates.description: You found traces of blood. Whoever was running in this direction may have been wounded. The trail leads to the North... Annon must be somewhere nearby.

candidates.title: Annon's side of the story
candidates.description: You've found a strange place with more traces of blood on it. Annon has to be here... When you find him, you should ask him why he ran away from Shuda.

candidates.title: Holy Threads
candidates.description: Boonthom asked you to bring back the following items to make the item with holy power: 1 needle Packet, 1 Spool, 1 Solid Husk, and 1 bottle of Holy Water. Then you will gain access to the 1st Underground Dungeon level.

candidates.title: The Stone Slate Message
candidates.description: Now that you have found the last part of the slate you should relay the message that you found to Boonthom

candidates.title: Holier Threads
candidates.description: Now you must bring back materials to Boonthom so that you can enter the 2nd underground level. Bring back 2 Holy Water, 1 Yggdrasil Leaf, 2 Needle Packet and 2 Spool.

candidates.title: Searching for the Sa-mhing Tiger
candidates.description: You can enter the 2nd underground level of the dungeon. Search for traces of Boonthom's Comrade who may have found out something about the Sa-mhing Tiger.

candidates.title: Boonthom's Comrade
candidates.description: You should go back to Boonthom and tell him about his comrade.

candidates.title: Benkaistein's Journal
candidates.description: Bring the journal to Digotz to remind him of all the good times they used to share together.

candidates.title: Benkaistein's Journal
candidates.description: Bring the journal to Maku to remind him of all the good times they used to share together.

candidates.title: Benkaistein's Journal
candidates.description: You have delivered Benkaistein's Journal to Digotz and Maku... You should check how Digotz is doing and let him know that Maku has read the journal.

candidates.title: Pass to the Slums
candidates.description: talk with Benkaistein.

candidates.title: Soothing a crying child 1
candidates.description: Find Torpy's mother out of the village.

candidates.title: Soothing a crying child 2
candidates.description: Deliver the mother's message to Torpy. (I'll be back…)

candidates.title: Soothing a crying child 3
candidates.description: Find Torpy's father who caused all the trouble. He must be hiding somewhere in the village.
candidates.goal: Find the cause of the mess

candidates.title: Soothing a crying child 4
candidates.description: Bring (Steamed Crab Nippers) to the Strange Man.

candidates.title: Soothing a crying child 5
candidates.description: Go tell Torpy and his mother about the ridiculous behavior of the strange man.

candidates.title: Job Quest 1 - Rogue
candidates.description: Deliver the letter to Haijara Greg's last son, Louis Greg.

candidates.title: Job Quest 2 - Rogue
candidates.description: Deliver the letter to Haijara Greg's 2nd son, Thor Greg.

candidates.title: Job Quest 3 - Rogue
candidates.description: Deliver the letter to Haijara Greg's first son, Jay Greg.

candidates.title: Job Quest 4 - Rogue
candidates.description: Deliver the letter to Haijara Greg's first son, Jay Greg.

candidates.title: Job Quest 5 - Rogue
candidates.description: Thor Greg will initiate the secret Rogue skill for you. You must pass Thor Greg's test.

candidates.title: Job Quest 6 - Rogue
candidates.description: Return to Haijara Greg for more information.
candidates.goal: Listen to the details of skill

candidates.title: Job Quest - Assassin
candidates.description: Talk with Defeattin to learn Venom Knife skill.

candidates.title: Job Quest - Assassin
candidates.description: Listen to Esmille carefully about learning Sonic Acceleration, and bring gemstones from certain places she mentions.

candidates.title: Pass to the Lab
candidates.description: Using the card pass, sneak into the lab.

candidates.title: Admission Restricted to the 102 Tower
candidates.description: It is restricted to generate the 102 Tower.

candidates.title: Orc's Memory Time Limit
candidates.description: The time limit for access to the Orc's Memory is 2 hours. After the time expires, your instance dungeon will be destroyed.

candidates.title: Today's Fishing Closed
candidates.description: Gorurung won't accept any of your fish pieces until one day has passed.
candidates.goal: Wait one day before turning in more fish

candidates.title: Concentration
candidates.description: Please be quiet at the fishing place.

candidates.title: Today's Mining Closed
candidates.description: No mining is allowed until 24 hours pass.

candidates.title: Limited time for enter
candidates.description: Only allowed to enter endless tower with limited time.
candidates.goal: Limited time for entering the tower

candidates.title: Thara Frog Hunting
candidates.description: Have you seen a red frog? It is called Thara Frog and it's very rare. We are trying to verify where it inhabits. So please hunt 20 Thara Frogs in the dungeon east of Comodo.

candidates.title: Cruiser Hunting
candidates.description: I heard of some toys attacking people. It is ridiculous! Let's show them our power! We have to hunt 15 Cruiser at the Toy Factory at Lutie.

candidates.title: Kukre Hunting
candidates.description: Someone got robbed near the beach! The possible suspect is a criminal monster called Kukre. Please hunt 30 Kukre at Byalan Dungeon.

candidates.title: Orc Baby Hunting
candidates.description: Orc Babies are getting more violent these days. Please hunt 15 Orc Babies at the Orc Village in Geffen Field.

candidates.title: Orc Warrior Hunting
candidates.description: Orc Warriors are increasing their aggression. Please hunt 20 Orc Warriors around the Orc Village in Geffen Field.

candidates.title: Vadon Hunting
candidates.description: Have you seen crabs with thick shells? They are Vadons. Please hunt 15 Vadons at Byalan Dungeon

candidates.title: Megalodon Hunting
candidates.description: Dead fish are all around the beach and it is getting worse. Please hunt 30 Megalodon at the dungeon east of Comodo.

candidates.title: Marse Hunting
candidates.description: Can you hunt Marse? I need 15 Marse for my study. Please help me! They are in Byalan Dungeon.

candidates.title: Cornutus Hunting
candidates.description: An idiot Cornutus bit the Mayor's foot. The Mayor is upset so we need to hunt 20 Cornutus at Byalan Dungeon to make him happy!

candidates.title: Myst Hunting
candidates.description: People are freaking out because of Myst. It looks like a ghost so, it scares people. Please hunt 15 Myst at the Mjolnir Dead Pit.

candidates.title: Shellfish Hunting
candidates.description: Don't ask why, but please hunt 30 Shellfish. It is a secret mission... you can find them 1 field south of Hugel or around Paros Lighthouse.

candidates.title: Marine Sphere Hunting
candidates.description: Marine Sphere? Do you know what a Marine Sphere is? I got a mission for you to hunt 15 Marine Sphere, so please do so at Byalan Dungeon

candidates.title: Phen Hunting
candidates.description: The mayor wants to eat a delicious fish dish. Phen will be the perfect ingredient for it. Please hunt 20 Phen at Byalan Dungeon!

candidates.title: Orc Skeleton Hunting
candidates.description: Dead Orc monsters got back to our town and they've revived as Orc Skeletons. We are in chaos! Please hunt 15 Orc Skeleton at the second floor of Orc Dungeon.

candidates.title: Zenorc Hunting
candidates.description: Some weird monsters called Zenorc are attacking us. Please hunt 30 Zenorcs at Orc Dungeon.

candidates.title: Mummy Hunting
candidates.description: Be prepared! It is a cruel mission! Hunt 15 Mummies!! I tried once, but I couldn't succeed. It is too scary in the Pyramid!

candidates.title: 41-55 Request
candidates.description: You are on a quest from the 41~55 request board.

candidates.title: Job Change to Royal Guard
candidates.description: Hainrich tells you that he is looking for Schmidtz's trace and any information about the Royal Guard.
candidates.goal: Continue conversation with the Middle-aged Gentleman Hainrich

candidates.title: Job Change to Royal Guard
candidates.description: Prove your asceticism and endurance by bringing 100 Burning Hearts to Hainrich in Prontera Castle.

candidates.title: Job Change to Royal Guard
candidates.description: You've collected the 100 Burning Hearts. Continue your conversation with Hainrich and listen to his story.

candidates.title: Job Change to Royal Guard
candidates.description: The last trace should be somewhere in the Glast Heim St. Abbey. The research says that it should be in the main church area.

candidates.title: Job Change to Royal Guard
candidates.description: The inscription says: "You are one who has holy power... Find my memory near my old castle of Glast Heim. My chambers were to the North..."

candidates.title: Job Change to Sorcerer
candidates.description: Find Karacas on the 4th floor of Geffen Tower.

candidates.title: Job Change to Sorcerer
candidates.description: Bring these materials to Karacas in Geffen Tower for the test to begin. 3 Wind of Verdure, 3 Crystal Blue, 3 Red Blood and 3 Green Live.

candidates.title: Tour of dungeon
candidates.description: Bring the 4 different elemental stones to these locations: 1st Floor of Ice Cave, 1st floor of Thor Volcano Dungeon, 3rd floor of Mjolnir Dead Pit, 2nd floor of Kunlun Dungeon and find the spirit detecting poles.
candidates.goal: Bring 3 different reagents to Karacas in Geffen Tower

candidates.title: Remove Root Cause
candidates.description: Baby dragons near the Yggdrasilberry roots are reportedly hatching. Eliminating the baby dragon is important because those baby dragons will eventually grow to be mean adults so we have to take them out while they're young. Hunt 10 Draco's Eggs, report to Hunting Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Violent Winged Insect
candidates.description: Received reports of sightings of an unknown huge winged insect near the Lapine camp recently. We don't know how far the infestation of this insect may spread so please exterminate as many as you spot. Hunt 12 Luciola Vespas, report to Hunting Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Work Interference
candidates.description: This just came in from colleagues working in the mine. The baby dragons living near Yggdrasilberry roots are destroying the grounds near the mines. It will get dangerous if we don't take care of it. Please wipe out the baby dragons near Yggdrasilberry. Hunt 5 Dracos, report to Hunting Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Intelligent Snakes
candidates.description: A new race called Naga was found at the swamp near the Lapine camp. The problem is that they are primitive intellectuals and are violent. We will have many conflicts with them in the future if they expand their colony. Please defeat the adult Nagas. Hunt 10 Nagas, report to Hunting Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Legendary Creature
candidates.description: We get continuous reports of sightings of a legendary winged white horse near by the Lapine base. Can you go there and take a look? It could be a hallucination so please make sure to touch it with your bare hand to make sure it is a living creature. Hunt 1 Cornus, report to Hunting Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Insects with an Appetite
candidates.description: Centipede's reproduction is another problem but their appetite is also threatening our survival. They absorb Bradium minerals and damage our mining grounds. Many of our Sapha colleagues have lost their lives to the Centipedes. Please exterminate them. Hunt 15 Centipedes, report to Hunting Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Moving Rocks
candidates.description: Got a report that Bradium raw minerals in the mines are alive. Looks like Bradium raw minerals were turned into Golems by an ancient spell and now we may need to close down our mines because of them. Can you please go and defeat them? Hunt 10 Bradium Golems around Manuk Field 2, report to Hunting Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: A child on a flower
candidates.description: Our scout who went to Splendide is being attacked by cute child looking monsters. So we need to hunt them inevitably, and you are the one for hunting them since you are not from Lapine. Hunt 15 Pinguiculas, report to Hunting Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hour.

candidates.title: Twisted Love
candidates.description: Are you aware of the child looking flower, Pinguicula? People say there has been a mutation of that flower. They are very violent and aggressive. Please go to check up and treat it before they are spread all over the area. Hunt 10 Dark Pinguicula in Nidhoggur Dungeon, report to Hunting Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Dangerous Plant Removal
candidates.description: Some mineral collectors are missing, and it seems to be done by nepenthes for sure. Nepenthes is similar to Mandragora. We gotta do something in order to protect people from more damage. Hunt 12 Nepenthes, report to Hunting Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Larva Extermination
candidates.description: They've discovered the centipede larva habitat. We can remove them now so there will be less centipedes. Would you find them and defeat them? You will have to be careful with the centipedes around them. Hunt 14 Centipede Larvas, report to Hunting Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Demon of Water
candidates.description: Miners heading to Nidhoggur's nest reported being attacked by a strange water creature. It's said that it was human-looking water creature. Perhaps the Nidhoggur Dungeon is the origin so please visit there to check up. Hunt 7 Aqua Elementals, report to Hunting Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Bird with ugly face
candidates.description: Tatachos were originally beautiful birds, and they could fly. But since they settled here where there is no natural enemy, they started to be fat and lazy. Eventually they became like now, such ugly birds. You will be a good natural enemy for them. Hunt 10 Tatachos, report to Hunting Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Withered Flower
candidates.description: This area was a wetland long ago. But for some reason the environment has changed over the years. There is a preserved of land nearby the Lapine camp. Can you bring me a Withered Flower sample? It will be to research on environmental changes. Collect 6 Withered Flowers, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Welcomed Mineral
candidates.description: The Bradium refine machinery is broken and now we are short supplying refined Bradium to our colleagues working at the mine. So we are using all our adventurers to help collect refined Bradium. Please bring back 3 refined Bradiums from the Bradium Golem. Collect 3 Refined Bradium, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Valuable Textile
candidates.description: I have a request to bring in 16 Dragon's Manes. Dragon's Mane is only dropped in small volumes by the Dracos and is very valuable. It is used in our indigenous designs in our flags, clothes and field equipment. Collect 16 Dragon's Mane, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Curious Meat
candidates.description: This is a request from the pub for the food of people from other worlds. They want Dragon Tails to use as a cooking ingredient for field food that can be stored extensively. So humans like this. Please bring back 6 of them. Collect 6 Dragon Tails, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Materials to Clear Snow
candidates.description: The path that goes out of the city is now a hazardous icy road because of the snow we've been getting. Spreading Pieces of Egg Shells will help and we need a lot of them. Around 26 or so will do. Collect 26 Piece of Egg Shells, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Best Cooler Material
candidates.description: The Bradium Processing Machinery emits tremendous heat when used and cannot be stabilized with any kind of water. So we mix Crystalized Teardrops obtained from Aqua Elementals from melted snow. we need daily so please bring back 6 of them. Collect 6 Crystalized Teardrop, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Best Paint
candidates.description: The Supply Manager has urgently requested paint to use on building maintenance throughout the city. He can make enough paint by using the Fluorescent Liquid obtained from Aqua Elementals. Please bring back 26 containers of it. Collect 26 Fluorescent Liquid, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Rare Valuable
candidates.description: The valuable interior water bottle in the minister's room is broken. They won't be able to find who did it because there are so many visitors every day. Can you please bring me this valuable item from Aqua Elemental? I only need 1. Collect 1 Small Bottle, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Armory Material
candidates.description: Lining supplies for armor for the Guards are all out. The scale shell from Naga are perfect lining material. Please bring back 18 of them. Collect 18 Scale Shells, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Advanced Armory Material
candidates.description: I got you a request named lining material for armor supplied to the guard commanders. They are different from ordinary lining. Please bring me 11 shining scales of Naga. I don't think it will be much trouble for you. Collect 11 Shining Scales, report to Supply Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Supervisor's Tool
candidates.description: It's time to repair the trumpets for Mine supervisors. Because those trumpets are necessary to control the miners. The mystic horn from Cornus is the perfect trumpet material, please get 5 pieces of them. Collect 5 Mystic Horns, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.
candidates.goal: Collect 5 Mystic Horns, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours

candidates.title: Preparation for Heating
candidates.description: It seems that there isn't enough amount of fur which is for the adventurers. It will be necessary to get some fur from Tatacho. 21 lumps will be enough. Collect 21 Fur, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Suspicious Food
candidates.description: There was a request from the pub to collect 27 bug legs. They don't wanna reveal the reason why they need them. Anyway, thank you. Collect 27 Bug Legs, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Useful Material
candidates.description: Zargon is very popular among the residents here. It's a beautiful, round shaped ball and can be used as an adhesive when its powder is mixed with water. Would you get some? It will be enough with 26 Zargons. Collect 26 Zargon, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Essential Material for Construction
candidates.description: There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work. Please get 13 Solid shells which can be obtained from Centipede and Centipede Larva. It will be very useful for the repair work. Collect 13 Solid Shells, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Essential Material for Construction 2
candidates.description: There is a request which is to find a material to be used for every quarter's building repair work. You need to get 16 Strong vines which can be got from nepenthes. It's a vital material for building repair work. Collect 16 Strong Vines, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Decoration arrangement
candidates.description: The guard need many sharp leaves for a decoration reason. Some other adventurers started searching them. They need pretty many quantity of the leaves so they want 26 sharp leaves from you. I know it's hard. Wish you good luck! Collect 26 Sharp Leaves, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Instant Receptacle
candidates.description: The pub owner is in trouble due to many adventurers from outside. He wishes to have an utensil which can be used simply and instantly... Something like a wide leaf. Collect 11 Great Leaves, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Not enough medicine
candidates.description: There have been couple of attacks in mine. It must be those Nepenthes that were trying to attack miners. In order to make the medicine, we need 16 brown roots. Find and bring them. Collect 16 Brown Root, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Honey robber
candidates.description: The pub owner came by and blamed and blamed about the big appetite of you guys. He said he has no more stock of honey and fruits. 2 jugs of honey will be enough to soothe him. Collect 2 Honey, report to Supply Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Tools for Experiment
candidates.description: The industrial research center researches ways of refining Bradium efficiently but they are always short on test materials. I heard there is a merchant in the adventurer's city who sells Life Force Pots. I will need 4 of them. Collect 4 Glass Tube, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Fine Gift Samples
candidates.description: The pub owner said he wants to give a gift to all his regular Sapha customers. But doesn't know what to give. If you see any interesting gifts in Midgard, can bring back 5 of them? Collect 5 Bouquets, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Respect for Taste!
candidates.description: The high minister is looking for the Midgard product, Witherless Roses these days. Not sure if it's a good gift but .... So... I know this is difficult to ask for but please bring me 1 Witherless Rose. This is just between you and me. Collect 1 Witherless Rose, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Courtesy for Regulars
candidates.description: A request from the pub owner. He says he can't use disposable leaf plates for regular customers. He is asking for 15 solid, white chinas from Midgard. Collect 15 Chinas, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Special Package
candidates.description: I have a personal request. I heard there is a round transparent handicraft in Midgard. I think they are called Glass Beads. We have similar manufactured items here but nothing compared to the elaborate sphere there. Please get me 10 of them. Collect 10 Glass Beads, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Dangerous Request
candidates.description: Hmm... I don't know how to start. The high minister is requesting for puppets from Midgard. I don't know what it is but since the high minister is asking for it, it must be used for a very important purpose. Please bring 15 of them. Collect 15 Puppets, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Strange Trend
candidates.description: I heard there is a trend among many of my colleagues here about a musical accessory made from a Bill of Birds from Midgard. I'm thinking of distributing them within the Operations building. Can you buy and bring back 50 of them? Collect 50 Bill of Birds, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Unknown Usage
candidates.description: The pub owner said he wanted to decorate the pub with something called Clam Shells. Please bring back about 50 of them. I have no idea how he will use them but I think he has a very unique taste after being acquainted with many adventurers. Collect 50 Clam Shells, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Other World Cuisine
candidates.description: We don't have cuisine for ourselves but many adventurers seem to enjoy the art of eating. So the pub owner needs a plate for his new cuisine. He asked for 20 Crab Shells. I have no idea where you can get them but... good luck. Collect 20 Crab Shells, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Filling in Cracks
candidates.description: I think the most useful Midgard item is Scells. Use Scells to fill any crack or holes in a building and then mix and plaster ground Garlet to it and the building is maintained quick and simple. Can you bring back 30 of them? Collect 30 Scells, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Adhesive Material
candidates.description: Garlets are an element in building maintenance. It is one of the most important materials in buildings. Before Garlets were available, we crushed and used Zargons but they have become difficult to come by. Please bring back 40 of them. Collect 40 Garlets, report to Transport Dept. 1 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Bait for Tatacho Hunting
candidates.description: Those Tatachos are so quick if we want to catch them which is pretty hard. So the galtens here lure them with Monster's Feed. It's said that there is an expert who does that job, please get 100 Monster's feed. Collect 100 Monster's Feed, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Swordmanship Practice
candidates.description: The pub owner wants some apple to learn how to cook well. But I never heard of any adventurers from Midgard who were fond of his food. Anyway he says that he will try, so get 100 apples for him. Collect 100 Apples, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Pretty reddish vegetable
candidates.description: This is a request from the pub owner. He wants some vegetable in order to have a colorful dish. Well... Carrot, is it? Anyway it's being called that in your land... I just was talking myself before. Please bring 100 of them. Collect 100 Carrots, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Tenacity of the pub owner
candidates.description: It's said that there had been an explosion in the pub. People say it was because of some vegetable named Pumpkin which was being roasted on the fire. Bring 100 pumpkins because they're all gone. Collect 100 Pumpkins, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Tastes like home cooking
candidates.description: The pub owner has another request... He misses potatos which he used to eat when he was young. He wants 50 sweet potatos. By chance if you visit Midgard, please try to get them. Collect 50 Potatos, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Hazardous plant when burnt
candidates.description: The pub owner wants to cook something strange. He said it will be Roasted Banana but I figure he's cooked something similar before... Well, I can't remember much. Anyway... you need to get 100 Bananas. Collect 100 Bananas, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Unexpectedly Normal
candidates.description: This request is from....the pub owner. He wants some meat. Nothing else in his request direction. It will be enough with 50 chunks. I wonder if he really is running his business... Collect 50 Meat, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Gift with heart
candidates.description: Few days ago, I saw the pub owner frustrated with all broken ladles... I felt sorry for him so I want you to get 20 black ladles which can be purchased in Midgard. Collect 20 Black Ladles, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Respect personal appetite!
candidates.description: The high minister wanted mirrors made from Midgard crystal. There are many Manukan mirrors but he seems to prefer the Midgard ones. I am actually a bit worried but there must be a reason for our "wise" high minister. Collect 5 Crystal Mirrors, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Resolution of the pub owner
candidates.description: The pub owner wants to try to make a special cocktail since he was so good at making poisons back in his assassin days. Collect 2 Pineapple, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.title: Rage of the pub owner
candidates.description: Find 2 Melons for the pub owner in El Dicastes. You can get these by hunting Galapagos or Grove. Collect 2 Melons, report to Transport Dept. 2 Manager within 23 hours.

candidates.description: You recently got a request from Laponte. Wait for 23 hours before accepting another request from him. He is waiting near the center of El Dicastes.

candidates.title: Dizziness
candidates.description: Continuous strong paper smell is making you feel dizzy. Wait a couple of hours before reading these documents again.

candidates.title: Tree Root Doc.
candidates.description: Humans are using this for firewood or construction material. Found commonly in the woods of Midgard.

candidates.title: Reptile Tongue Doc.
candidates.description: Tongue of a monster living in the desert terrain of Midgard. Often used as medicine after drying.

candidates.title: Scorpion Tail Doc.
candidates.description: Poisonous reptile tail from a creature living in the deserts. Records say that humans can lose their life when attacked.

candidates.title: Stem Doc.
candidates.description: There is nothing like Midgard plants in Manuk. These plants are used for food and medicine and some are even poisonous.

candidates.title: Pointed Scale Doc.
candidates.description: Stem from a bumpy life form. Research required as the usage is unknown.

candidates.title: Resin Doc.
candidates.description: Sap from an old tree collected and solidified. Very valuable in the human world.

candidates.title: Spawn Doc.
candidates.description: An egg from an amphibian living in warm areas. Unknown if this egg can hatch in Manuk's cold regions.

candidates.title: Jellopy Doc.
candidates.description: Unknown substance in Manuk regions but found throughout Midgard. Research required to see possibilities on using it for construction material.

candidates.title: Fish Tail Doc.
candidates.description: Humans eat meat called fish. Can be used as important food supply for foreign adventurers visiting in the city.

candidates.title: Worm Peeling Doc.
candidates.description: They say some Worm Peeling are valuable. But this is based on the human's standard of value. Research required.

candidates.title: Gill Doc.
candidates.description: There are Midgard creatures that live in the sea and breathe through gills. Further research on their ecology will be useful.

candidates.title: Tooth of Bat Doc.
candidates.description: Traces of a nocturnal creature unknown to Manuk. Not a strong creature from the size of its teeth.

candidates.title: Fluff Doc.
candidates.description: Many of Midgard creatures are covered with soft hair. Hair can be used as great cold protection. Further research required.

candidates.title: Chrysalis Doc.
candidates.description: Large insect sack that is alive and contains who knows what. Not active at all but the life structure within it is very unique and worth researching.

candidates.title: Feather of Birds Doc.
candidates.description: Bird feather located throughout Midgard. The feathers aren't great for cold protection but can be used as decorative accessories or tools for writing.

candidates.title: Talon Document Doc.
candidates.description: Pointy talon convenient for making holes or simple accessories. Very useful with the nails from large creatures from Manuk.^

candidates.title: Sticky Webfoot Doc.
candidates.description: Strange body structure found from Midgard amphibians. Evolved to better adapt to ocean life.

candidates.title: Animal Skin Doc.
candidates.description: Leather from a mammal. Very warm and soft and can be used in various ways. Processed in Midgard and valuable.

candidates.title: Wolf Claw Doc.
candidates.description: Claw from a creature called wolf. Usage is unknown but many curious Saphas are taking an interest in it.

candidates.title: Mushroom Spore Doc.
candidates.description: Spores from a mushroom found throughout Midgard. Looks like it can be cultivated here with a little research.

candidates.title: Orc's Fang Doc.
candidates.description: Green skinned monster living in the woods. The creature is humanlike but is very hostile to humans. Known to have a friendly relationship between the two races long ago.

candidates.title: Evil Horn Doc.
candidates.description: Item made from Evil Horns that appear in areas that aren't holy. Sold at a high price but doesn't seem to be practical.

candidates.title: Powder of Butterfly Doc.
candidates.description: Powder from the winged insects from Midgard. Some humans use it for makeup or medicine.

candidates.title: Bill of Birds Doc.
candidates.description: Pointy bill convenient for making holes or simple accessories. Looks similar to bird claws.

candidates.title: Snake Scale Doc.
candidates.description: Scales from a reptile that moves without legs. Scales are shed from the creature and are used for simple craftwork.

candidates.title: Insect Feeler Doc.
candidates.description: Bug feeler from an insect with keen nerves. Research subject for its unique structure different from Manuk creatures.

candidates.title: Immortal Heart Doc.
candidates.description: Heart that never stops beating. Obtained from mystical creatures called mermaids. The driving force of the heart is still unknown and worth researching.

candidates.title: Rotten Bandage Doc.
candidates.description: Bandage used for dead bodies. Looks like humans believed in the dead coming back for their bodies.

candidates.title: Decayed Nail Doc.
candidates.description: Nail from a dead body. Important material for research on time of death and health conditions. Useful in discovering human ecology.

candidates.title: Horrendous Mouth Doc.
candidates.description: Tooth from a dead body. Important material for research on time of death and health conditions. Useful in discovering human ecology.

candidates.title: Tentacle Doc.
candidates.description: Feeler from ocean creatures. Unlike those from insects, these show active movement.

candidates.title: Shell Doc.
candidates.description: Shell protecting insects or crustacean creatures. These creatures have a shell surrounding their skin and are very flexible in movement. Worth researching.

candidates.title: Scale Shell Doc.
candidates.description: Shiny scales found from some reptiles. The fluorescent substance contained on the surface can be used in various places.

candidates.title: Venom Canine Doc.
candidates.description: Canine tooth with poison. Humans use this to make weapons for defeating.

candidates.title: Sticky Mucus Doc.
candidates.description: Sticky liquid with a bit of viscosity left. Can be used as key material for construction and currently is used for some Manuk architecture style. Commonly found throughout Midgard.

candidates.title: Bee Sting Doc.
candidates.description: Stinger taken from a living insect. Some humans use it for medical treatment for its medicinal effect.

candidates.title: Grasshopper's Leg Doc.
candidates.description: Back legs of an insect that can leap far. Fun to research its structure.

candidates.title: Royal Jelly Doc.
candidates.description: A kind of wonder drug collected from a queen bee. Humans love this but no efficacy found for Manuk.

candidates.title: Yoyo Tail Doc.
candidates.description: Tail from a humanlike creature. Research on why humans do not have this trace on them would be amusing but would hurt current alliance with the humans.

candidates.title: Solid Shell Doc.
candidates.description: Shell evolved by some kind of environmental factor. This can be great material to make various tool or armory.

candidates.title: Yam Doc.
candidates.description: Edible when ripe, yellow food. Humans like this very much. Haven't tried it yet but smells like ripe sweet Potatoes.

candidates.title: Raccoon Leaf Doc.
candidates.description: They say there is an animal that can change its form with this pasted on it. Worth research to validate if this rumor is true.

candidates.title: Snail's Shell Doc.
candidates.description: Hard Carapace that protects the body of a huge snail. Creature fun to research out of pure curiousity.

candidates.title: Horn Doc.
candidates.description: Hard wedge-like horn from some insects. Doesn't have much practical use.

candidates.title: Bear's Footskin Doc.
candidates.description: Humans collect hunted bear paws. Usage is unknown. The humans that collect the paws are subjects for research.

candidates.title: Feather Doc.
candidates.description: Warm hair as soft as downy hair. Must be used for cold protection. Collectable throughout Midgard.

candidates.title: Red Herb Doc.
candidates.description: Kind of medicinal red plant. Humans use this to make recovery medicine. Plant worth researching.

candidates.title: Carrot Doc.
candidates.description: Red colored plant. Pub owner requests it all the time. Worth research.

candidates.title: Cactus Needle Doc.
candidates.description: Surface of a plant that survives in deserts with almost no moisture.

candidates.title: Stone Heart Doc.
candidates.description: They say a huge stone in a dead area in Midgard moves by itself. The heart of the huge stone would be a rare research subject.

candidates.title: Pouty Jahbong
candidates.description: Jahbong seems to be pouting seriously. You cannot talk with Jahbong for 6 hours. Would it be helpful to give him fish?

candidates.title: Request - Traces of wild boar hunt
candidates.description: As it seems ineffective only to raid Savages, we need a special operation. Slay living and fresh savages, come back to me with 30 manes of savages. I will warn them by spreading it on the road that they use to attack.

candidates.title: Lava Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 40 blazing hearts at the hottest place of the 2nd floor of Thor Volcano Dungeon.

candidates.title: Flame Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 10 Live Coals in the stable ground of Thor Volcano Dungeon.

candidates.title: Glacier Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 10 Glacial Hearts deep inside the Ice Cave.

candidates.title: Fossil Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 10 Jubilees on the 2nd floor of the Mine Dungeon.

candidates.title: Storm Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 10 Denture from Dragon Masks in the Kunlun dungeon.

candidates.title: Fruit-Carrying Insects
candidates.description: I'd like you to take them out as you see them, before they try to sell anything to the adventurers lost in the forest.

candidates.title: Flowery Hunters
candidates.description: No casualties have been reported yet, but it wouldn't hurt to take precautions. Please deal with them appropriately.

candidates.title: Small but Ferocious...
candidates.description: They didn't look so ferocious... but the adventurer has asked me to get rid of them, so you'll have to do it.

candidates.title: An Unknown Grudge
candidates.description: I don't know what grudge he has against the fairies, but a request is a request.

candidates.title: Blondie Ann
candidates.description: They don't seem so dangerous, but they are reported to steal books and sweets from adventurers. Please deal with them appropriately.

candidates.title: Request timer
candidates.description: Elephantine doesn't have anymore tasks available today.
candidates.goal: Wait for the timer to expire

candidates.title: Material for the Preservative
candidates.description: *grin* None other than... Insect Feelers! The General Goods Dealer there asked me to get four of them. I personally would not eat it for all the world...

candidates.title: A Symbol of Resistance
candidates.description: Immortal Hearts seem to be all the rage lately. The General Goods Merchant asked me to get five of them.

candidates.title: Material for First Aid Kits
candidates.description: They need tons of Rotten Bandages for making first aid bandages. They must have run out of new materials. The client is the General Goods Merchant over there. Three bunches of them will be enough.

candidates.title: Symbols of Courage
candidates.description: The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Orcish Vouchers, which are to be used to make symbols of courage.

candidates.title: Good for Stamina...
candidates.description: The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Skel-Bones, which are to be used to make tonic.

candidates.title: The Latest Trend in Talismans
candidates.description: Mementos serve as inspirations for designers of those cases. The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two of them.

candidates.title: Keep Your Valuables Safe
candidates.description: The Commodities Dealer across from me seems to make protective cases out of Shells. I was asked to get three of them.

candidates.title: Material for Shin Guards
candidates.description: The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get three Scale Shells, which are to be used to make shin guards.

candidates.title: Poison for Poison...
candidates.description: The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two Venom Canines, which are to be used in the research of the substance.

candidates.title: Don't Slip and Fall
candidates.description: The Commodities Dealer across from me commissioned me to get five globs of Sticky Mucus.

candidates.description: No more tasks are available today from Bow-wow
candidates.goal: Wait for the timer to expire

candidates.title: Information on missing person Tazar
candidates.description: Age 32. Comes from Midgard. Has been missing for 3 months since he went to the Maze of the Hazy Forest in order to collect the native plants. Survival not likely.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 13, 10

candidates.title: Information on missing person Nigel
candidates.description: Age 19. Adventurer who came from far away unknown place by ship. He has been missing for 2 months since he went to explore Maze dressed thin tights despite the protests of all of Mora's residents.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 10, 24

candidates.title: Information on missing person Messil
candidates.description: Age unknown. Has little bit of a mental illness. He went alone in order to purify the Maze of the Hazy forest.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 14, 24

candidates.title: Information on missing person Noirit
candidates.description: Age 51. He used to be a biggest thief who stole famous swords from all over the world. He's gone missing in the Maze after being pursued for running illegal casino house which caused massive casualties in his final years.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 19, 27

candidates.title: Information on missing person Pajama Sin
candidates.description: Age 22. Pilot cadet of airship. He has gone missing during his leave while drinking in Mora town. Rumor has it that he fled after signing somewhere. Has been missing for 4 months. Slim chance of survival.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 30, 32

candidates.title: Information on missing person Mendel^
candidates.description: Age Unknown. A Female with long hair dressed black. Go on an expedition to the forest of Maze for search for eternal life. Has been missing for 3 months. Slim chance of survival.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 33, 28

candidates.title: Information on the missing person Milebit
candidates.description: Age around 50. The current Mayor of the Mora village. He ran away to the Forest of Maze after being caught from pocketing profit by cheating residence. Survival uncertain
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 33, 17

candidates.title: Information on the missing person Kunmoon
candidates.description: Age 29. A young man with unknown background. Fled to the forest of maze after scamming 1200 Mora coins from Mora residents while pretending to start a lot of business and adapting himself in Mora. Survival uncertain
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 28, 8

candidates.title: Information on the missing person Chaihokin
candidates.description: Age 34.Flurted with several women in Mora. Fled from Mora villagers to the forest of maze. Survival Uncertain
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 17, 5

candidates.title: Information on missing person Tual
candidates.description: Age Unknown.Disappered with coins which were joint controlled by the villagers. Slim Chance of Survival
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 11, 4

candidates.description: You already have got 1 requested service. Since you already have done it, you cannot get a new request for 7 days.

candidates.title: Towards Bakonawa Lake...
candidates.description: Entered the lake to stop Bakonawa. Don't think I need to go back into the lake within the week.

candidates.title: Get Rid of Bakonawa
candidates.description: A huge fight will break out if Bakonawa is left as is. He must be defeatd.

candidates.title: A suspicious prisoner
candidates.description: It seems that a suspicious prisoner is in jail. Wouldn't be nice to hear about his story for once?

candidates.title: An unwanted favor
candidates.description: Clever asks for 1 ^000099Grape Extract Herb Tea^000000. It is a big favor coming from a prisoner, but try to obtain it when possible.

candidates.title: Gossip king Clever
candidates.description: Clever knows lots of gossip stories. Since his knowledge may be helpful for future adventures, let's listen to them. There may be very useful information.

candidates.title: The rift researcher
candidates.description: There is a young Dona named ^000099Hielle^000000 who is known to carry out research related to rift fragments. Look for the researcher.

candidates.title: A cat merchant's source of information
candidates.description: Among cat merchants, there is a cat that is supposed to know a lot about Midgard research on rifts. Look for ^000099Midgard Post^000000 known for its activity.
candidates.goal: A cat merchant's source of information

candidates.title: A way to calm down a cat
candidates.description: If the cat is stopped from fighting, it may be possible to gain useful information. How can it be calmed down? Did they say that they could not get their monthly salary of ^000099Malangdo Canned Specialties^000000?
candidates.goal: A way to calm down a cat

candidates.title: Information traded for some canned foods
candidates.description: It is told that ^0000991 Dark Debris, 2 of each red/yellow/blue gemstones^000000 are needed for activating the rift fragment. It seems that Hiel is having a hard time obtaining them…
candidates.goal: Information traded for some canned foods

candidates.title: A weird experience
candidates.description: Experiment with Hiel whether sufficient reaction occurs with the rift fragment.

candidates.title: A successful experience
candidates.description: With Hiel's current arrangement, it doesn't seem like it will react properly. Try touching the experimental setup to activate it.

candidates.title: Another visitation
candidates.description: The identities found through the rift reaction must be actual figures from history. Ask Clever the historian about them.

candidates.title: Clever's historical documents
candidates.description: There are individuals that seem to be Lapines according to Clever's historical documents. Listen to his stories.

candidates.title: Hidden historical documents (?)
candidates.description: According to Clever's drawn diagram, the document doesn't seem too hidden. Rather, it seems well presented on the shelves. Look for places where books are organized in Eclage.

candidates.title: The unknown ones
candidates.description: Individuals responsible for constructing the Home Tree and restoring the land of Bifrost are not the Elder's Assembly, but two unknown Dona's. Ask Clever about two Donas named Etran and Robert.

candidates.title: Figures in history
candidates.description: Clever asked to directly talk with the historical figures of the past through the rift device. Not sure if it is possible, but go visit Hiel.

candidates.title: Tour of Eclage
candidates.description: Take Robert who appeared in the past around the many places of Eclage. Wouldn't he be touched if he were to see the current state of Home Tree?

candidates.title: Error
candidates.description: Robert suddenly vanished. Go back to Hiel to figure out if something went wrong with the rift device.

candidates.title: Fun times with the reactor
candidates.description: Use Hiel's rift reactor to explore various areas of Eclage. There may be a place where Etran appears.

candidates.title: Encountering Etran
candidates.description: The location where Etran can be reached was found. It would be a good chance to confirm whether he was responsible for restoring the land.

candidates.title: Two wishes
candidates.description: Deliver Etran's necklace to Robert. Obtain Home Tree's golden leaf. Two favors were asked. Ask Hiel about the method to obtain a Home Tree leaf.

candidates.title: Revisiting Robert
candidates.description: It is prohibited to injure Home Tree by obtaining a leaf. However, if the creator himself provides one, it may be okay. However, wasn't Robert just abandoned in front of Home Tree last time?

candidates.title: Revisitng Etran
candidates.description: Show Home Tree's leaf and encourage Etran. Although Robert's refusal to receive the necklace was critical...

candidates.title: Two remaining friends
candidates.description: Robert and Etran will carry out their destinies until the end. Until the land of the past (although present for them…) becomes the abundant land of the present. Talk with Hiel and Clever who made the encounters possible.

candidates.title: Salim Hamid
candidates.description: Talked with a merchant trainer named Salim Hamid.

candidates.title: Applicant for trader

candidates.description: It seems Dragon living inside cave is a bit angry these days. Dragon's condition is being checked daily by Vigilante member, please check what's wrong.

candidates.title: No news is not a good news
candidates.description: The guy went to check Dragon's status hasn't come back yet. Something must have happened. Follow me to the cave.

candidates.title: How is the Dragon
candidates.description: Found a big scary enemy today, I couldn't check Tartufi yet... Is Tartufi ok... Check please...

candidates.title: Chief Basilisk
candidates.description: Please meet Imoogi, the chief of Basilisks and ask to keep them calm. There is a device you for you to converse with somewhere up there.

candidates.title: Lord Imuk's message
candidates.description: Basilisk will continue their duty until that young one gives up the Yeouiju.

candidates.title: Basilisk Hunt
candidates.description: Please take care of those while I look for Yeouiju. Eliminating 20 of them usually do the work.

candidates.title: We can start sail now
candidates.description: Took care of Basilisk, Tartufi is now calmed down. Report back to First officer Stello.

candidates.title: Whole new world of taste
candidates.description: I'm trying to research the new continent's food ingredients. Would you get me 4 Fruits of Mastera? And I also do need 1 Cat shape hard biscuit.
candidates.goal: 4 Mastera's Fruit and 1 Cat shape Hard Biscuit

candidates.title: There also is a scary thing for me
candidates.description: Those appear at night and creep me out so much. They said new hero could help me out. Please meet Shamanyang and listen to the solution of my problem. Shamanyang lives at the entry way of the village.

candidates.title: Truth is alway harsh
candidates.description: Tell Boatswain the story I just told you.

candidates.title: Dirty Creatures
candidates.description: I would never hang out with Basilisk. So get me 20 Basils and 5 Basilrocks. Ofcourse there will be a treat.

candidates.title: Charm Effect Duration
candidates.description: Charm effect will go away at 4 O'clock

candidates.title: New Ingredient
candidates.description: As more contact with new continent people happening, we discovered that their charms are also effective. Today, we need 5 Basilrocks and 1 Holy water. Get them and report to Boatswain.

candidates.title: Dirty and Filty
candidates.description: Basilrock is so dirty and filty. 20 Basilrocks would do for today. Get them and report to Boatswain at once.

candidates.title: The basic are the best
candidates.description: Stick to the basic is the most effective way. Collect Basil 20 ea and Basil lock 5 ea. As soon as you get them, go to Boatswain right away.

candidates.title: Free time
candidates.description: Today's work is not finished. We can't research without our work is done. Come back after dawn time.

candidates.title: I love buns, too
candidates.description: It is said there is bun in the new continent. There is a similar food in Lasagna, so I would like to compare them. Can you bring me 20 of them?

candidates.title: Emergency food supplies
candidates.description: I wonder was Nyas used to feed all those sailors from Navi. Please get me 5 each of them.

candidates.title: Brilliant idea
candidates.description: Unmelting ice!! If it exists, that will be a revolution in keeping ingredients! That stimulates my curiosity! Please collect 20 of them!

candidates.title: Kaluna milk is in Danger!
candidates.description: Haven't heard anything from Mr.Legalas who is supposed to get me Kahlugna. Please meet Mr.Legalas, see what's going on. He lives down south.

candidates.title: Time to persuade
candidates.description: We'll be starved to death! Do something! Talk with them, stop them from eating anymore Kahlugnag!!

candidates.title: Babysitter
candidates.description: Let's find a baby needing care.

candidates.title: Processing Anchovy
candidates.description: They want to do something related to anchovy. Let's go to anchovy workshop.

candidates.title: Anchovy fishing ship
candidates.description: They want to get on the ship, so they might get used to anchovy shipping. Let's visit anchovy fishing ship.

candidates.title: Helpless...
candidates.description: I am sick and tired of hanging around with those two able to do nothing and having any will to do. I should return to Mr.Legalas without an alternative

candidates.title: I need the time on my own
candidates.description: I could do some work while they were not here. I should do some finishing, so please hang around with them for a while. And please tell Mr.Kalu about that I will deliver the procucts very soon.

candidates.title: Meal Box Delivery
candidates.description: I can make them stay away from Mr.Legalas to let him do his work. Could you deliver this lunch box to vigilante Panna in the cave? Of course, you should bring them along.

candidates.title: Delivery Complete Report
candidates.description: Finished deliver meal box to Vigilante member. Let's go back to Kalu.

candidates.title: Meal Box Delivery Time
candidates.description: Delivery time is not now. Wait for after dawn and come back.

candidates.title: Meal Box Delivery
candidates.description: Help me with Meal Box Delivery to Vigilante Pana inside the cave!
candidates.goal: Delivery to Vigilante member inside cave

candidates.title: Delivery Complete Report
candidates.description: Finished deliver meal box to Vigilante member. Let's go back to Kalu.

candidates.title: Interview with Captain
candidates.description: Talk with Captain Gamberi, ask him this and that. And tell me what you heard.

candidates.title: To Recorder
candidates.description: Finished interview with Captain Gamberi. Let's go back to Recorder.

candidates.title: Interview with the Chief
candidates.description: Talk with Peperoncino, ask him about Captain Gamberi and others. Come back and tell me what you heard. Chief Peperoncino is staying at Adventurer Club's diner.

candidates.title: To Recorder
candidates.description: Finished interview with Peperoncino. Let's go back to Recorder.

candidates.title: To Granma
candidates.description: Find the Granma trapped in time, ask for Captain and Chief. Come back and tell me what she said. Granma lives near by Pub-Oven.

candidates.title: Back to Recorder
candidates.description: Finished all the interview now, let's go back to Recorder.

candidates.title: The Competition
candidates.description: Take care of 10 Wild Hornets for the honey harvest competition, and report back to Chief or Florin.

candidates.title: Sticky ingredient
candidates.description: We are lack of Webfoot for making puddings. Hunt down 10 Sweet Roda Frogs and collect 5 Sticky Webfoots, report back to Chief or Shepherd.
candidates.goal: Defeat Sweet Roda Frog and collect 5 Sticky Webfoots

candidates.title: Hunter's destination
candidates.description: They say hunter desert wolves are stealing dry fishes. Hunt down 10 of them and report back to Chief or Shepherd.

candidates.title: Secret Ingredient
candidates.description: Trance Spore's Mashroom spore is the secret ingredient of fish cake. Hunt 10 Trace Spore and bring back 5 mashroom spore to Chief or Shepherd.

candidates.title: Resting Time
candidates.description: Get some rest for hard work tomorrow.

candidates.title: Preparing for the Firework Festival
candidates.description: Gasters drop deadly poisonous powder and explosive powder. Bring me 10 Deadly Poisonous Powders and 1 Explosive Powder. Oh, and don't forget to cull Gasters by hunting 15 of them.
candidates.goal: 10 Deadly Poisonous Powders and 1 Explosive Powder

candidates.title: Time to Make Bombs
candidates.description: You've brought me enough ingredients to make bombs all night. Come back early in the morning tomorrow. That's the best time to do things. - Demon

candidates.title: Mysterious Device
candidates.description: You can see the device of great crystal shape if you look around where you arrive. Close in with it so that you could use the device.

candidates.title: Make snow flower bouquet
candidates.description: Find the Snow flower illusionist. If you are interested find the place.

candidates.title: To get through hot winter
candidates.description: Snow for the region where it does not fall, Cotton clothes for cold region! If you wish to get through the winter find Coti and Ulsi.

candidates.title: Exchange festival card
candidates.description: Did you find a special card from your gift box? Then bring it to Twinkle. You will receive a special gift.

candidates.title: Make snow flower bouquet
candidates.description: You need 10 magical snow flowers to make a snow flower bouquet. Please don't forget 1 carrot for decorating the snowman. - Marine

candidates.title: Chilly feeling is remained
candidates.description: The magical snow flower effect is still remains. Please comeback after the dawn. - Marine

candidates.title: Getting through winter
candidates.description: Snow for children! Warm cotton clothes for children in cold region! Donate 10 warm cotton!

candidates.title: Cotton is being wrapped
candidates.description: Cotton is being wrapped. The wrapping seems be be finished by dawn so please come back after dawn! - Coti

candidates.title: Exchange festival card
candidates.description: The lucky word for you is WINTER!! Please open snow flower envelope from your gift box. In the envelope, you can find these letters W. I. N. T. E. R.. Total of 6 letters. - Twinkle

candidates.title: Exchange festival card
candidates.description: The lucky word for you is SNOW!! Please open snow flower envelope from your gift box. In the envelope, you can find these letters S. N. O. W. Total of 4 letters. - Twinkle

candidates.title: Exchange festival card
candidates.description: The lucky word for you is FESTIVAL!! Please open snow flower envelope from your gift box. In the envelope, you can find these letters F. E. S. T. I. V. A. L. Total of 8 letters. - Twinkle

candidates.title: Exchange festival card
candidates.description: The lucky word for you is FLOWER!! Please open snow flower envelope from your gift box. In the envelope, you can find these letters F. L. O. W. E. R. Total of 6 letter. - Twinkle

candidates.title: Card exchange is once a day
candidates.description: Alphabet card exchange is once a day. Okay? So please comeback after dawn! - Twinkle

candidates.title: Experiencing abnormal statuses
candidates.description: As an apology, I will let you experience the abnormal statuses in advance.
candidates.goal: Talk with the trainer Mainz again

candidates.title: Hold your breath
candidates.description: Talk with me after holding your breath for 20 seconds!
candidates.goal: Speak with trainer Argos after 20 seconds

candidates.title: In need of COCOA BEAN
candidates.description: Take care of Sweets Drops monsters from fields and dungeons. Get back to Charles with 20 stolen COCOA BEANs.

candidates.title: Chocolate Delivery
candidates.description: Deliver chocolates in order of Geffen, Payon, Aldebarn, Prontera Sweets Shops.

candidates.title: Chocolate Delivery Complete
candidates.description: Finished chocolate delivery Charles requested. You can repeat after 4 AM.

candidates.title: Daily Draw Limitation
candidates.description: Sweets Shop Draw is only possible once a day. Today you've draw one alredy, so let's try after tomorrow 4 AM.

candidates.description: You read a notice on a board asking for adventurers to go on a once in a lifetime quest from Metz Brayde.

candidates.title: First examination
candidates.description: You find out that you have to go through a series of tests from Metz's friends. The first friend is in Morocc named Arian. You should go there and see him if you want to continue.

candidates.title: Fetching Items for Arian -1
candidates.description: Bring only what I tell you to bring. If you know that I'll be asking for something later and you happen to have it, I'll straight up jack it. Gimme ^FF0000100 Fluff^000000.

candidates.title: Quiz time!
candidates.description: Talk with Ganaan to progress to the next part of the exam.

candidates.title: Gen of Niflheim
candidates.description: Crayu says that you need to talk with someone in Niflheim named ^FF0000Gen^000000.

candidates.title: The Witch's Aid
candidates.description: Gen suggests that you go and see the witch and ask her to help you out. He also added that you should be wary of Serin.

candidates.title: Misfortunate of Niflheim
candidates.description: Serin says that you should talk with some of the people around Niflheim and see if you can be of any help to them.

candidates.title: The Queen's Symbol
candidates.description: You must earn the queen's favor in order to get the Symbol of the Nine Realms. Find where her lost mother, Agrboda has been sealed away by asking others if they know anything about her.

candidates.title: Knowledge of the Symbol
candidates.description: Serin said that you should someone who may have lived in Asgard and may know more about where Agrboda is sealed away.

candidates.title: Knowledge of Asgard
candidates.description: Valkyrie could not provide any answers for you. Perhaps someone in Niflheim can help you with your search for Agrboda.

candidates.title: Finding the Soul Pieces
candidates.description: Laichin has given you directions on how to find the 4 Soul Pieces of Agrboda. But what does he mean by "big" or "small" and what. You better ask him for clarification

candidates.title: Finding the Soul Pieces
candidates.description: For big, Look near the border of the map. For small, look in between the border and center. For very small, look near the center. Check out big 1 o'clock, big 5 o'clock, big 7 o'clock, and the small 6 o'clock.

candidates.title: Finding the Soul Pieces
candidates.description: For big, Look near the border of the map. For small, look in between the border and center. For very small, look near the center. Check out big 4 o'clock, big 10 o'clock, small 6 o'clock, and the very small 11 o'clock.

candidates.title: Finding the Soul Pieces
